quote: Those studies have focused on the impacts of IMP on immunity, gut health and growth performance in farmed species.
statement: 现有研究主要关注IMP对养殖物种免疫、肠道健康和生长性能的影响。
text_zh: 现有研究主要关注IMP对养殖物种免疫、肠道健康和生长性能的影响。
text_en: Existing research mainly focuses on the effects of IMP on immunity, gut health, and growth performance in farmed species.
outcome: 免疫、肠道健康、生长性能

quote: To the best of our knowledge, this is the ﬁrst report on the effects of IMP on liver health and muscle quality in farmed ﬁsh.
statement: 据作者所知，这是关于IMP对养殖鱼类肝脏健康和肌肉品质影响的首次报告。
text_zh: 据作者所知，这是关于IMP对养殖鱼类肝脏健康和肌肉品质影响的首次报告。
text_en: To the authors' knowledge, this is the first report on the effects of IMP on liver health and muscle quality in farmed fish.

quote: On 17 April 2007, mature broodfish of common carp were fished with gillnets in earthen ponds, selected, and moved to indoor cement tanks (six 3-m3 tanks for the females and one 3-m3 tank for the males) in the State Carp Hatchery in Psathotopi (western Greece).
statement: 成熟鲤鱼亲鱼通过刺网捕捞、筛选后转移至室内水泥池中。
text_zh: 成熟鲤鱼亲鱼通过刺网捕捞、筛选后转移至室内水泥池中。
text_en: Mature carp broodstock are captured by gill nets, screened, and then transferred to indoor concrete pools.

population.system: earthen ponds to indoor cement tanks

quote: Females were weighted, marked with coded metal fin clips, and divided in two groups, the experimental and the control group, each consisted of 30 individuals.
statement: 雌鱼被称重，使用编码金属鳍夹进行标记，并分为实验组和对照组，每组各30条个体。
text_zh: 雌鱼被称重，使用编码金属鳍夹进行标记，并分为实验组和对照组，每组各30条个体。
text_en: Female fish were weighed, marked with coded metal fin clips, and divided into experimental and control groups, with 30 individuals in each group.

quote:
Concerning the drawbacks of pituitary extracts com-
pared to purified LH preparations, there is still a potential
for transmission of diseases to recipient broodfish
statement: 与纯化的LH制剂相比，垂体提取物存在将疾病传播给受体亲鱼的风险。
text_zh: 与纯化的LH制剂相比，垂体提取物存在将疾病传播给受体亲鱼的风险。
text_en: Compared to purified LH preparations, pituitary extracts carry a risk of transmitting diseases to recipient broodstock.

quote: During the feeding trial, the ﬁsh were fed their corresponding diets to apparent satiation three times per day (8:30, 14:00 and 18:00) for 60 days.
statement: 在喂养试验期间，鱼每天三次（8:30、14:00和18:00）被喂至表观饱食，持续60天。
text_zh: 在喂养试验期间，鱼每天三次（8:30、14:00和18:00）被喂至表观饱食，持续60天。
text_en: During the feeding trial, fish were fed to apparent satiation three times daily (8:30, 14:00, and 18:00) for 60 days.

quote: The dissolved oxygen content was maintained above 7.5 mg L-1, and the ammonia nitrogen content was lower than 0.5 mg L-1.
statement: 溶解氧含量维持在7.5 mg/L以上，氨氮含量低于0.5 mg/L。
text_zh: 溶解氧含量维持在7.5 mg/L以上，氨氮含量低于0.5 mg/L。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen content is maintained above 7.5 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen content is below 0.5 mg/L.

quote: Another two ﬁsh were anaesthetized with MS-222 (100 mg L−1 tricaine methane sulfonate, Argent Chemical Laboratories Inc., Redmond, WA, USA).
statement: 另外两条鱼用MS-222（100 mg/L三卡因甲磺酸盐）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 另外两条鱼用MS-222（100 mg/L三卡因甲磺酸盐）进行麻醉。
text_en: The other two fish were anesthetized with MS-222 (100 mg/L tricaine methanesulfonate).

quote: Dietary IMP supplementation could alleviate lipid deposition and improve the liver health of gibel carp.
statement: 日粮补充IMP可以减轻脂质沉积并改善鲫鱼肝脏健康。
text_zh: 日粮补充IMP可以减轻脂质沉积并改善鲫鱼肝脏健康。
text_en: Dietary IMP supplementation can reduce lipid deposition and improve liver health in crucian carp.

quote: To observe the pathological changes in the liver, liver specimens were embedded in parafﬁn wax and sectioned to a thickness of 4 mm. The sections were stained with haematoxylin-eosin (H&E) to observe the histopathological changes in the liver.
statement: 将肝脏标本包埋于石蜡中并切片至4微米厚度，使用苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色以观察肝脏的组织病理学变化。
text_zh: 将肝脏标本包埋于石蜡中并切片至4微米厚度，使用苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色以观察肝脏的组织病理学变化。
text_en: Liver specimens were embedded in paraffin and sectioned to a thickness of 4 micrometers, using hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining to observe histopathological changes in the liver.

quote: Only alive specimens (n = 204) were selected for decapitation.
statement: 仅选择活体样本（n = 204）进行去头处理。
text_zh: 仅选择活体样本（n = 204）进行去头处理。
text_en: Only live samples (n = 204) were selected for decapitation.
outcome: 样本质量与处理前状态

quote: we found that dietary IMP supplementation was able to signiﬁcantly reduce the serum levels of AST and ALT, and this phenomenon is likely the result of improved liver function
statement: 膳食补充IMP显著降低了血清AST和ALT水平，这可能归因于肝功能的改善。
text_zh: 膳食补充IMP显著降低了血清AST和ALT水平，这可能归因于肝功能的改善。
text_en: Dietary IMP supplementation significantly reduced serum AST and ALT levels, which may be attributed to improved liver function.

quote: We found that IMP supplementation reduced the gene expression levels of these cytokines in the liver, which suggested that dietary IMP supplementation could reduce the inﬂammatory response in the liver of gibel carp.
statement: IMP补充降低了肝脏中炎症细胞因子（TGF-b, IL-6, TNF-a, IL-1b）的基因表达水平，表明膳食补充IMP可能减轻鲫鱼的肝脏炎症反应。
text_zh: IMP补充降低了肝脏中炎症细胞因子（TGF-b, IL-6, TNF-a, IL-1b）的基因表达水平，表明膳食补充IMP可能减轻鲫鱼的肝脏炎症反应。
text_en: IMP supplementation reduced the gene expression levels of inflammatory cytokines (TGF-b, IL-6, TNF-a, IL-1b) in the liver, indicating that dietary IMP supplementation may alleviate hepatic inflammation in crucian carp.

quote: This study found that dietary IMP supplementation could reduce fat accumulation and decrease the inflammatory response of the liver.
statement: 本研究发现膳食补充IMP可以减少脂肪积累并降低肝脏炎症反应。
text_zh: 本研究发现膳食补充IMP可以减少脂肪积累并降低肝脏炎症反应。
text_en: This study found that dietary supplementation with IMP can reduce fat accumulation and lower liver inflammatory responses.

quote: In the present study, the lipid level in the basal diet was slightly higher than that in commercially produced feed and led to the accumulation of fat in the livers of gibel carp.
statement: 在本研究中，基础日粮中的脂质水平略高于商业生产的饲料，导致鲫鱼肝脏中脂肪积累。
text_zh: 在本研究中，基础日粮中的脂质水平略高于商业生产的饲料，导致鲫鱼肝脏中脂肪积累。
text_en: In this study, the lipid level in the basal diet was slightly higher than that of commercially produced feed, leading to fat accumulation in the liver of crucian carp.

quote: Excessive dietary fat intake could increase the concentration of free fatty acids in the blood and increase the levels of triglycerides stored in the liver, causing lipid accumulation (Honma et al., 2012).
statement: 过量的膳食脂肪摄入可能会增加血液中游离脂肪酸的浓度和肝脏中储存的甘油三酯水平，从而导致脂质积累（Honma等人，2012）。
text_zh: 过量的膳食脂肪摄入可能会增加血液中游离脂肪酸的浓度和肝脏中储存的甘油三酯水平，从而导致脂质积累（Honma等人，2012）。
text_en: Excessive dietary fat intake may increase the concentration of free fatty acids in the blood and the level of triglycerides stored in the liver, leading to lipid accumulation (Honma et al., 2012).
outcome: 血液生化指标与肝脏脂质积累

quote: In previous studies, it was revealed that exogenous IMP exerts growth-promoting and immune-enhancing effects (Song et al., 2012).
statement: 先前的研究表明，外源性IMP具有促进生长和增强免疫的效果。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，外源性IMP具有促进生长和增强免疫的效果。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that exogenous IMP has effects of promoting growth and enhancing immunity.

quote: There was no signiﬁcant difference in the weight gain, speciﬁc growth rate and feeding rate among the experimental groups (P > 0.05) (Table S2).
statement: IMP supplementation did not significantly affect weight gain, specific growth rate, or feeding rate.
text_en: IMP supplementation did not significantly affect weight gain, specific growth rate, or feeding rate.

quote: We observed obvious fat deposition and pathological damage in the livers of gibel carp after the feeding experiment (Figures 1A–C).
statement: Obvious fat deposition and pathological damage were observed in the livers of gibel carp after the feeding experiment.
text_en: Obvious fat deposition and pathological damage were observed in the livers of gibel carp after the feeding experiment.

quote: Additionally, the plasma levels of ALT and AST, important indicators of liver function, were signiﬁcantly reduced in the 0.4% IMP group (P < 0.05) (Figures 1H, I).
statement: Plasma levels of ALT and AST, which are indicators of liver function, were significantly reduced in the 0.4% IMP group.
text_en: Plasma levels of ALT and AST, which are indicators of liver function, were significantly reduced in the 0.4% IMP group.

quote: In the metabolites content, the results were showed the signiﬁcant linear correlation between the ALT, AST contents and dietary IMP contents.
statement: 在代谢物含量方面，结果显示ALT和AST含量与饲料IMP含量之间存在显著的线性相关。
text_zh: 在代谢物含量方面，结果显示ALT和AST含量与饲料IMP含量之间存在显著的线性相关。
text_en: In terms of metabolite content, the results showed a significant linear correlation between ALT and AST content and dietary IMP content.

quote: In the relative genes expression, the results were showed that the signiﬁcant linear correlation between the hepatic inﬂammatory cytokines genes (IL-6 and IL-1b), hepatic glycolipid genes (acc, fas, cpt1a, pepck, g6pase and glut4), lipid metabolism genes (srebp1 and lpl) in muscle and dietary IMP contents.
statement: 在相对基因表达方面，结果显示肝脏炎症因子基因（IL-6和IL-1b）、肝脏糖脂基因（acc, fas, cpt1a, pepck, g6pase和glut4）以及肌肉中的脂质代谢基因（srebp1和lpl）与饲料IMP含量之间存在显著的线性相关。
text_zh: 在相对基因表达方面，结果显示肝脏炎症因子基因（IL-6和IL-1b）、肝脏糖脂基因（acc, fas, cpt1a, pepck, g6pase和glut4）以及肌肉中的脂质代谢基因（srebp1和lpl）与饲料IMP含量之间存在显著的线性相关。
text_en: In terms of relative gene expression, the results showed significant linear correlations between dietary IMP content and liver inflammatory factor genes (IL-6 and IL-1b), liver glucose and lipid metabolism genes (acc, fas, cpt1a, pepck, g6pase and glut4), and muscle lipid metabolism genes (srebp1 and lpl).
outcome: 基因表达（炎症、糖脂代谢）

quote:
The AMP/ATP ratio in the 0.4% IMP
group was signiﬁcantly higher than that in the control group
(P < 0.05)
statement: 0.4% IMP组的AMP/ATP比值显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 0.4% IMP组的AMP/ATP比值显著高于对照组。
text_en: The AMP/ATP ratio in the 0.4% IMP group was significantly higher than that in the control group.

quote: In conclusion, our study revealed that exogenous IMP could reduce liver fat content and thus maintain liver health in gibel carp.
statement: 外源性IMP可降低肝脏脂肪含量，从而维持银鲫的肝脏健康。
text_zh: 外源性IMP可降低肝脏脂肪含量，从而维持银鲫的肝脏健康。
text_en: Exogenous IMP can reduce liver fat content, thereby maintaining the liver health of gibel carp.

quote:
Compared with
those in the 0% IMP group, the TGF-b, IL-6 and IL-1b
expression levels were dramatically decreased in the 0.4 IMP
group (P < 0.05).
statement: 与对照组相比，0.4% IMP组的TGF-b、IL-6和IL-1b表达水平显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，0.4% IMP组的TGF-b、IL-6和IL-1b表达水平显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the expression levels of TGF-b, IL-6 and IL-1b in the 0.4% IMP group were significantly reduced.

quote:
Thus, IMP reduced hepatic lipid droplet
deposition and ameliorated hepatocyte quality
statement: IMP减少了肝脏脂滴沉积并改善了肝细胞质量。
text_zh: IMP减少了肝脏脂滴沉积并改善了肝细胞质量。
text_en: IMP reduced hepatic lipid droplet deposition and improved hepatocyte quality.

quote: No Lc was detected following the cessation of bacterial supplementation and 100% water renewal up to the end of the experiments.
statement: 在停止细菌补充并进行100%换水后，直到实验结束未检测到Lc。
text_zh: 在停止细菌补充并进行100%换水后，直到实验结束未检测到Lc。
text_en: After stopping bacterial supplementation and performing a 100% water change, Lc was not detected until the end of the experiment.

quote: Several Gs colonies were occasionally detected in the first week, whereas no Gs were detected after the second water renewal during the post-administration period.
statement: 在给药后期间的第一周偶尔检测到Gs菌落，但在第二次换水后未检测到Gs。
text_zh: 在给药后期间的第一周偶尔检测到Gs菌落，但在第二次换水后未检测到Gs。
text_en: Gs colonies were occasionally detected during the first week after administration, but were not detected after the second water change.

quote: L. casei (Lc) is one of the species commonly used in aquaculture [ 4 , 17 ] and has shown some beneficial properties when applied to fish [ 23 , 24 ].
statement: 干酪乳杆菌是水产养殖中常用的物种之一，并在应用于鱼类时显示出一些有益特性。
text_zh: 干酪乳杆菌是水产养殖中常用的物种之一，并在应用于鱼类时显示出一些有益特性。
text_en: Lactobacillus casei is one of the commonly used species in aquaculture and has shown some beneficial properties when applied to fish.

quote: During the baseline and post-administration periods, 100% of the water was renewed every 5 days in both experiments.
statement: 在基线和给药后期间，两个实验中每5天更换100%的水。
text_zh: 在基线和给药后期间，两个实验中每5天更换100%的水。
text_en: During the baseline and post-administration periods, 100% of the water was changed every 5 days in both experiments.

quote: Tap water was equilibrated to room temperature and aerated for 48 h before use.
statement: 自来水在使用前被平衡至室温并曝气48小时。
text_zh: 自来水在使用前被平衡至室温并曝气48小时。
text_en: Tap water was equilibrated to room temperature and aerated for 48 hours before use.

quote: The physical parameters of the water were as follows: temperature 22–25 °C, pH 8.0–9.0, and dissolved oxygen > 6 mg/L.
statement: 水的物理参数如下：温度22–25°C，pH值8.0–9.0，溶解氧>6 mg/L。
text_zh: 水的物理参数如下：温度22–25°C，pH值8.0–9.0，溶解氧>6 mg/L。
text_en: The physical parameters of the water were as follows: temperature 22–25°C, pH 8.0–9.0, dissolved oxygen >6 mg/L.

quote: The fish were sacrificed at the sampling point, and close to the entire GI tract, from the esophagus to the anus, was aseptically removed.
statement: 鱼在采样点被处死，并从食道到肛门无菌地取出几乎整个胃肠道。
text_zh: 鱼在采样点被处死，并从食道到肛门无菌地取出几乎整个胃肠道。
text_en: Fish were euthanized at the sampling site, and nearly the entire gastrointestinal tract was aseptically removed from the esophagus to the anus.
outcome: 实验操作对动物的影响

quote: For the Mixed diet, Lc and Gs suspension were prepared and sprayed on the sterile basal feed to achieve a final concentration of 1 × 10 7 cfu/g in Experiment 1.
statement: 在实验1中，将Lc和Gs悬浮液喷洒在无菌基础饲料上，使最终浓度达到1 × 10^7 cfu/g。
text_zh: 在实验1中，将Lc和Gs悬浮液喷洒在无菌基础饲料上，使最终浓度达到1 × 10^7 cfu/g。
text_en: In Experiment 1, Lc and Gs suspensions were sprayed onto sterile basal feed to achieve a final concentration of 1 × 10^7 cfu/g.

quote: The final concentrations of Lc and Gs were 2 × 10 9 cfu/g and 1 × 10 8 cfu/g in Experiment 2, respectively.
statement: 在实验2中，Lc和Gs的最终浓度分别为2 × 10^9 cfu/g和1 × 10^8 cfu/g。
text_zh: 在实验2中，Lc和Gs的最终浓度分别为2 × 10^9 cfu/g和1 × 10^8 cfu/g。
text_en: In Experiment 2, the final concentrations of Lc and Gs were 2 × 10^9 cfu/g and 1 × 10^8 cfu/g, respectively.

quote: Lactic acid bacteria (LAB) are commonly applied to fish as a means of growth promotion and disease prevention.
statement: 乳酸菌通常被应用于鱼类以促进生长和预防疾病。
text_zh: 乳酸菌通常被应用于鱼类以促进生长和预防疾病。
text_en: Lactic acid bacteria are usually applied to fish to promote growth and prevent disease.

quote: Sterile feed irradiated with 60 Co was used to eliminate the influence of microbes, and 100% rearing water was renewed at 5-day intervals to reduce the fecal–oral circulation of microbes.
statement: 使用经钴-60辐照的无菌饲料以消除微生物影响，并每5天更换100%养殖水以减少微生物的粪口循环。
text_zh: 使用经钴-60辐照的无菌饲料以消除微生物影响，并每5天更换100%养殖水以减少微生物的粪口循环。
text_en: Use sterile feed irradiated with cobalt-60 to eliminate microbial effects, and replace 100% of the culture water every 5 days to reduce fecal-oral circulation of microbes.

quote: treatment groups were fed with a mixed diet containing Lc (1 × 10 7 cfu/g) and spore of Geobacillus stearothermophilus (Gs, 1 × 10 7 cfu/g) during the administration period and a sterile basal diet during the baseline and post-administration periods.
statement: 处理组在给药期间喂食含有干酪乳杆菌ATCC 393和嗜热脂肪地芽孢杆菌孢子的混合日粮，而在基线期和给药后期喂食无菌基础日粮。
text_zh: 处理组在给药期间喂食含有干酪乳杆菌ATCC 393和嗜热脂肪地芽孢杆菌孢子的混合日粮，而在基线期和给药后期喂食无菌基础日粮。
text_en: The treatment group was fed a mixed diet containing Lactobacillus casei ATCC 393 and Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores during the administration period, while being fed a sterile basal diet during the baseline period and the post-administration period.

quote: Given the restrictions and prohibitions regarding the use of chemicals and antibiotics, there is an increasing demand for safe, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly feed supplements that possess exceptional benefits for farmed fish such as phytogenics, prebiotics and probiotics [ 1 ].
statement: 鉴于对化学品和抗生素使用的限制和禁令，人们对具有植物源、益生元和益生菌等安全、经济高效且环保的饲料补充剂的需求日益增加。
text_zh: 鉴于对化学品和抗生素使用的限制和禁令，人们对具有植物源、益生元和益生菌等安全、经济高效且环保的饲料补充剂的需求日益增加。
text_en: Due to restrictions and bans on the use of chemicals and antibiotics, there is an increasing demand for safe, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly feed supplements such as phytogenic compounds, prebiotics, and probiotics.

quote: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan nilai kecerahan ikan komet berkisar 4,28-9,09, kandungan karotenoid sisik ikan 6,50 µmol/g- 9,44 µmol/g, karotenoid pakan 0,97µmol/g-1,2µmol/g, pertumbuhan berat mutlak 5,26 g-6,07g, pertumbuhan panjang mutlak 2,43-2,85 cm, pertumbuhan spesifik 2,46-2,72 %/hari, feed convertion ratio (FCR) 1,55-1,73, survival rate 97,8-100.
statement: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan kisaran nilai kecerahan, kandungan karotenoid, parameter pertumbuhan, FCR, dan tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet.
text_en: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan kisaran nilai kecerahan, kandungan karotenoid, parameter pertumbuhan, FCR, dan tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet.
intervention_record: 南瓜和万寿菊提取物饲料

quote: The fish were distributed into six separate glass aquariums (300 L) at a density of 24 fish per tank.
statement: 鱼被分配到六个独立的玻璃水族箱中，每个水箱容量300升，密度为每箱24条鱼。
text_zh: 鱼被分配到六个独立的玻璃水族箱中，每个水箱容量300升，密度为每箱24条鱼。
text_en: Fish were assigned to six independent glass aquaria, each with a capacity of 300 liters, at a density of 24 fish per tank.

quote: First was the 21-day long, baseline period, during which the fish from both groups were fasted for 7 days and then acclimatized to the sterile pellet feed at 1.0–1.5% body weight once a day for 14 days.
statement: 在基线期，两组鱼先禁食7天，随后适应无菌颗粒饲料，投喂量为体重的1.0-1.5%，每天一次，持续14天。
text_zh: 在基线期，两组鱼先禁食7天，随后适应无菌颗粒饲料，投喂量为体重的1.0-1.5%，每天一次，持续14天。
text_en: During the baseline period, fish in both groups were first fasted for 7 days, then acclimated to sterile pellet feed, fed at a rate of 1.0-1.5% of body weight once daily for 14 days.

quote: During the administration period, the mixed diet was orally administered in both experiments for 7 days.
statement: 在给药期间，两个实验中均通过口服方式给予混合饲料7天。
text_zh: 在给药期间，两个实验中均通过口服方式给予混合饲料7天。
text_en: During the administration period, mixed feed was given orally for 7 days in both experiments.

quote: One of therapeutic benefits of probiotics are that they can colonize or temporally colonize gastrointestinal (GI) tract and thereby modulate the intestinal microbiota via competitive adherence and exclusion, resulting in the production of beneficial substances for the host
statement: Probiotics provide therapeutic benefits by colonizing the GI tract and modulating intestinal microbiota through competitive adherence and exclusion, leading to the production of beneficial substances.

quote: Once the fish had stable growth and adapted to the water environment, they were randomly assigned to groups for bacterial infection and immunity experiments.
statement: 一旦鱼类生长稳定并适应水环境，它们被随机分组进行细菌感染和免疫实验。
text_zh: 一旦鱼类生长稳定并适应水环境，它们被随机分组进行细菌感染和免疫实验。
text_en: Once fish growth stabilized and they adapted to the water environment, they were randomly assigned to bacterial infection and immune experiments.

text_en: Serangan ektoparasit menimbulkan dampak negatif yang terlihat jelas pada bagian luar tubuh ikan.

text_en: Serangan parasit pada ikan budidaya menghambat pertumbuhan dan mempengaruhi kelangsungan hidup.

statement: Gangguan metabolisme akibat parasit dapat merusak organ seperti insang, lambung, dan usus, yang berujung pada hambatan pertumbuhan hingga kematian.
text_en: Gangguan metabolisme akibat parasit dapat merusak organ seperti insang, lambung, dan usus, yang berujung pada hambatan pertumbuhan hingga kematian.

quote: The survival rates of Carassius auratus were measured after challenging with the virulent strain A. veronii TH0426 , resulting in the relative survival rates of 64% for Intraperitoneal vaccine group, 56% for Intramuscular vaccine group, 52% for oral vaccine group, and 48% for immersion vaccine group.
statement: 在攻毒试验中，腹腔注射疫苗组的相对存活率为64%，肌肉注射疫苗组为56%，口服疫苗组为52%，浸泡疫苗组为48%。
text_zh: 在攻毒试验中，腹腔注射疫苗组的相对存活率为64%，肌肉注射疫苗组为56%，口服疫苗组为52%，浸泡疫苗组为48%。
text_en: In the challenge test, the relative survival rate was 64% for the intraperitoneal injection vaccine group, 56% for the intramuscular injection vaccine group, 52% for the oral vaccine group, and 48% for the immersion vaccine group.

quote: Analysis of bacterial load in the liver, spleen, and kidney post-challenge showed a decreasing trend in the control group, indicating that the vaccine strain ΔhisJ could gradually restrict the rapid proliferation of bacteria in these tissues, thereby providing a certain level of immune protection against A. veronii .
statement: 攻毒后对肝、脾和肾脏细菌载量的分析显示对照组呈下降趋势，表明疫苗株ΔhisJ能逐渐限制这些组织中细菌的快速增殖，从而提供一定程度的免疫保护。
text_zh: 攻毒后对肝、脾和肾脏细菌载量的分析显示对照组呈下降趋势，表明疫苗株ΔhisJ能逐渐限制这些组织中细菌的快速增殖，从而提供一定程度的免疫保护。
text_en: Analysis of bacterial loads in the liver, spleen and kidney after challenge showed a downward trend in the control group, indicating that the vaccine strain ΔhisJ can gradually limit the rapid proliferation of bacteria in these tissues, thereby providing a certain degree of immune protection.
outcome: 细菌感染负荷/免疫保护

quote: In brief, the vaccine strain ΔhisJ can serve as a safe live attenuated vaccine for Carassius auratus , and this study lays the foundation for the development of live attenuated vaccines against Aeromonas veronii .
statement: 总之，疫苗株ΔhisJ可作为鲫鱼的安全减毒活疫苗，本研究为开发针对维氏气单胞菌的减毒活疫苗奠定了基础。
text_zh: 总之，疫苗株ΔhisJ可作为鲫鱼的安全减毒活疫苗，本研究为开发针对维氏气单胞菌的减毒活疫苗奠定了基础。
text_en: In conclusion, the vaccine strain ΔhisJ can serve as a safe live attenuated vaccine for crucian carp, and this study lays the foundation for developing live attenuated vaccines against Aeromonas veronii.

quote: Dari identifikasi berdasarkan kriteria morfologi yang telah ditentukan dapat diketahui bahwa pada ikan mas koki yang diamati terdapat ektoparasit dari kelas Monogenea dan Cestoidea.
statement: Identifikasi morfologi menemukan adanya ektoparasit dari kelas Monogenea dan Cestoidea pada ikan mas koki.
text_en: Identifikasi morfologi menemukan adanya ektoparasit dari kelas Monogenea dan Cestoidea pada ikan mas koki.

text_en: Hasil identifikasi menunjukkan dua ekor Dactylogyrus sp pada ikan pertama, tidak ada parasit pada ikan kedua, dan satu ekor Unitubulotestis sardae pada ikan ketiga.
counterevidence: Tidak ditemukan parasit pada ikan ke-2

quote: A total of 120 Carassius auratus , evenly divided into 8 groups, were immunized with different types and doses of vaccines.
statement: 总共120条鲫鱼被平均分为8组，并用不同类型和剂量的疫苗进行免疫。
text_zh: 总共120条鲫鱼被平均分为8组，并用不同类型和剂量的疫苗进行免疫。
text_en: A total of 120 crucian carp were equally divided into 8 groups and immunized with different types and doses of vaccines.

quote: Over a period of 14 ds, meticulous daily monitoring was conducted to record the mortality rates of Carassius auratus .
statement: 在14天内，进行了细致的每日监测以记录鲫鱼的死亡率。
text_zh: 在14天内，进行了细致的每日监测以记录鲫鱼的死亡率。
text_en: Within 14 days, meticulous daily monitoring was conducted to record the mortality of crucian carp.

quote: However, immersion immunization consumes a large amount of vaccine and often provides low protection and short immunity duration (20).
statement: 浸浴免疫消耗大量疫苗，且通常提供较低的保护力和较短的免疫持续时间。
text_zh: 浸浴免疫消耗大量疫苗，且通常提供较低的保护力和较短的免疫持续时间。
text_en: Bath immunization consumes a large amount of vaccine and usually provides lower protection and shorter duration of immunity.

quote: Our research group’s earlier construction of an hisJ -deleted vaccine of A.veronii (namely ΔhisJ) achieved good immune protection in the Loach (16 , 21).
statement: 研究团队早期构建的维氏气单胞菌hisJ缺失疫苗（ΔhisJ）在泥鳅中实现了良好的免疫保护。
text_zh: 研究团队早期构建的维氏气单胞菌hisJ缺失疫苗（ΔhisJ）在泥鳅中实现了良好的免疫保护。
text_en: The Aeromonas veronii hisJ deletion vaccine (ΔhisJ) constructed by the research team in early stages achieved good immune protection in loach.

quote: The safety evaluating results of the vaccine showed that intraperitoneal and intramuscular injection of the vaccine caused inflammatory reactions at the injection site, while oral and immersion immunization routes did not result in significant stress response.
statement: 疫苗安全性评估结果显示，腹腔注射和肌肉注射导致注射部位炎症反应，而口服和浸浴免疫途径未引起显著应激反应。
text_zh: 疫苗安全性评估结果显示，腹腔注射和肌肉注射导致注射部位炎症反应，而口服和浸浴免疫途径未引起显著应激反应。
text_en: Vaccine safety assessment results showed that intraperitoneal and intramuscular injection caused inflammatory responses at the injection site, while oral and immersion immunization routes did not cause significant stress responses.

quote: The relative survival rates were obtained as 64% in the IpV group, 56% in the ImV group, 52% in the OV group, and 48% in the IV group.
statement: 各组相对存活率分别为：腹腔注射组64%，肌肉注射组56%，口服组52%，浸浴组48%。
text_zh: 各组相对存活率分别为：腹腔注射组64%，肌肉注射组56%，口服组52%，浸浴组48%。
text_en: The relative survival rates for each group were: intraperitoneal injection group 64%, intramuscular injection group 56%, oral administration group 52%, and immersion group 48%.

quote: After disinfection of the fish surfaces through immersion in potassium permanganate and saline solution, they were temporarily housed in aquarium tanks in the Aquaculture Laboratory of Jilin Agricultural University.
statement: 鱼体表面经高锰酸钾和盐水溶液浸浴消毒后，被暂时饲养在水族箱中。
text_zh: 鱼体表面经高锰酸钾和盐水溶液浸浴消毒后，被暂时饲养在水族箱中。
text_en: After disinfection by immersion in potassium permanganate and salt water solutions, the fish bodies were temporarily kept in aquariums.
intervention: Potassium permanganate and salt bath disinfection
intervention_record: 高锰酸钾和盐水浸浴消毒

quote: Vaccination is proposed as a substitute for antibiotics in aquaculture to decrease disease-related mortality and morbidity.
statement: 疫苗接种被提议作为水产养殖中抗生素的替代品，以降低与疾病相关的死亡率和发病率。
text_zh: 疫苗接种被提议作为水产养殖中抗生素的替代品，以降低与疾病相关的死亡率和发病率。
text_en: Vaccination is proposed as an alternative to antibiotics in aquaculture to reduce disease-related mortality and morbidity.

quote: Immunization via these administration routes was safe for Carassius auratus , with intraperitoneal and intramuscular injections causing stronger adverse reactions.
statement: 通过这些给药途径对鲫鱼进行免疫接种是安全的，但腹腔注射和肌肉注射引起了较强的不良反应。
text_zh: 通过这些给药途径对鲫鱼进行免疫接种是安全的，但腹腔注射和肌肉注射引起了较强的不良反应。
text_en: Immunization of crucian carp via these routes is safe, but intraperitoneal and intramuscular injection caused stronger adverse reactions.
counterevidence: 腹腔和肌肉注射引起较强不良反应

quote: Immersion immunization resulted in mild adverse reactions, and no significant adverse reactions were observed following oral immunization.
statement: 浸泡免疫导致轻微不良反应，而口服免疫未观察到显著不良反应。
text_zh: 浸泡免疫导致轻微不良反应，而口服免疫未观察到显著不良反应。
text_en: Bath immersion vaccination caused minor adverse reactions, while no significant adverse reactions were observed with oral vaccination.

quote: Immunizing Carassius auratus at safe concentrations via these routes enhanced the phagocytic activity in serum, increased the levels of non-specific immune-related enzymes (ACP, AKP, C3, C4, LZM, SOD, and IgM), and improved specific serum antibody levels.
statement: 以安全浓度通过上述途径对鲫鱼进行免疫增强了血清吞噬活性，提高了非特异性免疫相关酶水平，并改善了特异性血清抗体水平。
text_zh: 以安全浓度通过上述途径对鲫鱼进行免疫增强了血清吞噬活性，提高了非特异性免疫相关酶水平，并改善了特异性血清抗体水平。
text_en: Immunizing crucian carp via the above routes at a safe concentration enhanced serum phagocytic activity, increased levels of non-specific immunity-related enzymes, and improved specific serum antibody levels.

quote: It also elevated levels of cytokines related to inflammatory responses (IL-1β, IL-10, TNF-α, TGF-β) in organ tissues (liver, spleen, kidney, mid-post intestine, and gills).
statement: 它还提高了器官组织中与炎症反应相关的细胞因子水平。
text_zh: 它还提高了器官组织中与炎症反应相关的细胞因子水平。
text_en: It also increased the levels of cytokines associated with inflammatory responses in organ tissues.
outcome: 炎症反应细胞因子水平

quote: With the widespread popularization of intensive farming, bacterial diseases in Carassius auratus have become frequent
statement: 集约化养殖的普及导致鲫鱼细菌性疾病频发。
text_zh: 集约化养殖的普及导致鲫鱼细菌性疾病频发。
text_en: The prevalence of intensive farming has led to frequent bacterial diseases in crucian carp.

quote: Clinical symptoms of infection mainly include septicemia, gill rot, enteritis, skin ulcers, and visceral infections.
statement: 感染的临床症状主要包括败血症、烂鳃、肠炎、皮肤溃疡和内脏感染。
text_zh: 感染的临床症状主要包括败血症、烂鳃、肠炎、皮肤溃疡和内脏感染。
text_en: The clinical symptoms of infection mainly include septicemia, gill rot, enteritis, skin ulcers, and visceral infections.

quote: In aquaculture, A.veronii infection can lead to high mortality rates, causing significant economic losses.
statement: 在水产养殖中，维氏气单胞菌感染可导致高死亡率并造成重大经济损失。
text_zh: 在水产养殖中，维氏气单胞菌感染可导致高死亡率并造成重大经济损失。
text_en: In aquaculture, Aeromonas veronii infection can lead to high mortality and cause significant economic losses.

quote: Vaccine immunization is another important measure to prevent and control bacterial infections.
statement: 疫苗免疫是预防和控制细菌感染的另一项重要措施。
text_zh: 疫苗免疫是预防和控制细菌感染的另一项重要措施。
text_en: Vaccination is another important measure for preventing and controlling bacterial infections.

quote: TH0426 was administered through intraperitoneal injection, each injection consisting of 200 μL of bacterial solution at concentrations ranging from 2 × 10 8 to 2 × 10 4 CFU/mL.
statement: 菌株 TH0426 通过腹腔注射给药，每次注射包含 200 μL 浓度为 2 × 10^8 至 2 × 10^4 CFU/mL 的细菌溶液。
text_zh: 菌株 TH0426 通过腹腔注射给药，每次注射包含 200 μL 浓度为 2 × 10^8 至 2 × 10^4 CFU/mL 的细菌溶液。
text_en: Strain TH0426 was administered by intraperitoneal injection, with each injection containing 200 μL of bacterial solution at a concentration of 2 × 10^8 to 2 × 10^4 CFU/mL.

quote: During the immersion tests, the TH0426 and ΔhisJ culture was added to the aquarium, with the fish being immersed for 30 min in solutions containing bacterial concentrations ranging from 2 × 10 8 to 2 × 10 4 CFU/mL, and from 2 × 10 9 to 2 × 10 5 CFU/mL.
statement: 在浸泡测试期间，将 TH0426 和 ΔhisJ 培养物加入水族箱中，鱼在含有特定细菌浓度的溶液中浸泡 30 分钟。
text_zh: 在浸泡测试期间，将 TH0426 和 ΔhisJ 培养物加入水族箱中，鱼在含有特定细菌浓度的溶液中浸泡 30 分钟。
text_en: During the immersion test, TH0426 and ΔhisJ cultures were added to the aquariums, and fish were immersed in a solution containing specific bacterial concentrations for 30 minutes.

quote: Researchers prepared a live attenuated A.veronii vaccine by suppressing the expression of SmpB, to immunize Zebrafish , and achieved a survival rate of 65% after challenge with a virulent strain (13).
statement: 研究人员通过抑制SmpB表达制备了维氏气单胞菌减毒活疫苗，对斑马鱼进行免疫，并在强毒株攻击后实现了65%的存活率。
text_zh: 研究人员通过抑制SmpB表达制备了维氏气单胞菌减毒活疫苗，对斑马鱼进行免疫，并在强毒株攻击后实现了65%的存活率。
text_en: Researchers prepared an attenuated live vaccine of Aeromonas veronii by inhibiting SmpB expression, immunized zebrafish with it, and achieved a survival rate of 65% after challenge with a virulent strain.

quote: A tolC gene-deleted live attenuated vaccine significantly reduced tissue damage in Hyriopsis cumingii infected by a virulent strain (14).
statement: tolC基因缺失的减毒活疫苗显著减少了被强毒株感染的三角帆蚌的组织损伤。
text_zh: tolC基因缺失的减毒活疫苗显著减少了被强毒株感染的三角帆蚌的组织损伤。
text_en: A live attenuated vaccine with a tolC gene deletion significantly reduced tissue damage in Hyriopsis cumingii infected with a highly virulent strain.

quote: An hcp gene-deleted attenuated vaccine immunized the largemouth bass, achieving a 100% survival rate, significantly higher than the 76.67% survival rate of the formalin inactivated vaccine immunization group (15).
statement: hcp基因缺失的减毒疫苗免疫大口黑鲈，实现了100%的存活率，显著高于福尔马林灭活疫苗免疫组的76.67%存活率。
text_zh: hcp基因缺失的减毒疫苗免疫大口黑鲈，实现了100%的存活率，显著高于福尔马林灭活疫苗免疫组的76.67%存活率。
text_en: Immunization of largemouth bass with an attenuated vaccine lacking the hcp gene achieved a 100% survival rate, significantly higher than the 76.67% survival rate in the group immunized with the formalin-inactivated vaccine.

quote: Our research group prepared a live attenuated vaccine by knocking out the hisJ gene, which enabled a survival rate of 65.66% in the Loach against the virulent strain (16).
statement: 研究团队通过敲除hisJ基因制备了减毒活疫苗，使泥鳅在对抗强毒株时达到了65.66%的存活率。
text_zh: 研究团队通过敲除hisJ基因制备了减毒活疫苗，使泥鳅在对抗强毒株时达到了65.66%的存活率。
text_en: The research team prepared a live attenuated vaccine by knocking out the hisJ gene, achieving a survival rate of 65.66% in loach when challenged with a highly virulent strain.

quote: The safety of the live attenuated vaccines raises concerns, particularly regarding their potential reversion to virulence or adverse effects in immunocompromised individuals.
statement: 减毒活疫苗的安全性引起担忧，特别是关于其潜在毒力回复或对免疫功能低下个体的不利影响。
text_zh: 减毒活疫苗的安全性引起担忧，特别是关于其潜在毒力回复或对免疫功能低下个体的不利影响。
text_en: The safety of live attenuated vaccines raises concerns, particularly regarding their potential reversion to virulence or adverse effects on immunocompromised individuals.

quote: For vaccines used in immersion immunization (IV group), the culture of ΔhisJ is added to the aquarium to achieve a concentration of 2 × 10 7 CFU/mL.
statement: 浸泡免疫组将ΔhisJ培养物加入水族箱以达到2 × 10^7 CFU/mL的浓度。
text_zh: 浸泡免疫组将ΔhisJ培养物加入水族箱以达到2 × 10^7 CFU/mL的浓度。
text_en: The immersion immunization group added ΔhisJ culture to the aquarium to reach a concentration of 2 × 10^7 CFU/mL.

quote: For vaccines used in oral immunization (OV group), the concentration of the ΔhisJ is adjusted to 2 × 10 7 CFU/mL, and for every 200 μL of bacterial solution, it is mixed with 100 g of fish feed.
statement: 口服免疫组将ΔhisJ浓度调整为2 × 10^7 CFU/mL，每200微升细菌溶液与100克鱼饲料混合。
text_zh: 口服免疫组将ΔhisJ浓度调整为2 × 10^7 CFU/mL，每200微升细菌溶液与100克鱼饲料混合。
text_en: The oral immunization group adjusted the ΔhisJ concentration to 2 × 10^7 CFU/mL, mixing 200 microliters of bacterial solution with 100 grams of fish feed.

quote: For the OV group, fish were fed vaccine-coated feed at a dose of 2% of body weight, continuously for 5 ds, and after the immunization, they were fed non-vaccine-coated feed.
statement: 口服免疫组以体重的2%剂量连续5天喂食包被疫苗的饲料，免疫后改喂非疫苗包被饲料。
text_zh: 口服免疫组以体重的2%剂量连续5天喂食包被疫苗的饲料，免疫后改喂非疫苗包被饲料。
text_en: The oral immunization group was fed vaccine-coated feed at a dose of 2% of body weight for 5 consecutive days, and then switched to non-vaccine-coated feed after immunization.

quote: After the immunization, continuous observation was carried out for 1 week, and the clinical symptoms and mortality rate of Carassius auratus in each group were recorded.
statement: 免疫后连续观察一周，记录各组鲫鱼的临床症状和死亡率。
text_zh: 免疫后连续观察一周，记录各组鲫鱼的临床症状和死亡率。
text_en: Clinical signs and mortality of crucian carp in each group were recorded during one week of continuous observation after immunization.

quote: The relative percent survival for each group was calculated based on the mortality rates using the formula: Relative Percent Survival = 1 − mortality rate in immunized group / mortality rate in control group × 100 % .
statement: 相对存活率是根据免疫组和对照组的死亡率通过特定公式计算的。
text_zh: 相对存活率是根据免疫组和对照组的死亡率通过特定公式计算的。
text_en: Relative survival rate was calculated from the mortality rates of the immunized group and the control group using a specific formula.

quote: The administration routes of fish vaccine include injection, oral, and immersion.
statement: 鱼类疫苗的给药途径包括注射、口服和浸泡。
text_zh: 鱼类疫苗的给药途径包括注射、口服和浸泡。
text_en: The routes of administration for fish vaccines include injection, oral, and immersion.

quote: The site for muscle injection is generally the muscle at the base of the dorsal fin or tail fin of the fish, while the intraperitoneal injection site is often inside the peritoneum at the base of the ventral fin.
statement: 肌肉注射部位通常是鱼背鳍或尾鳍基部的肌肉，而腹腔注射部位通常是腹鳍基部内侧的腹膜内。
text_zh: 肌肉注射部位通常是鱼背鳍或尾鳍基部的肌肉，而腹腔注射部位通常是腹鳍基部内侧的腹膜内。
text_en: The intramuscular injection site is usually the muscle at the base of the dorsal or caudal fin, while the intraperitoneal injection site is usually inside the peritoneum at the base of the pelvic fin.

quote: The injection route produces strong immune protection and long-lasting immunity, but the injection process is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and highly stressful for the fish.
statement: 注射途径产生强免疫保护和持久免疫力，但注射过程耗时、劳动密集且对鱼造成高度应激。
text_zh: 注射途径产生强免疫保护和持久免疫力，但注射过程耗时、劳动密集且对鱼造成高度应激。
text_en: The injection route produces strong immune protection and lasting immunity, but the injection process is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and causes high stress to fish.

quote: The oral immunization route involves mixing the vaccine with feed and administering it orally when the fish feed, saving a lot of manpower and avoiding the stress and irreversible damage caused to the fish during the injection process.
statement: 口服免疫途径涉及将疫苗与饲料混合并在鱼摄食时经口给予，节省大量人力并避免注射过程中对鱼造成的应激和不可逆损伤。
text_zh: 口服免疫途径涉及将疫苗与饲料混合并在鱼摄食时经口给予，节省大量人力并避免注射过程中对鱼造成的应激和不可逆损伤。
text_en: The oral immunization route involves mixing the vaccine with feed and administering it orally when fish eat, saving a large amount of labor and avoiding stress and irreversible damage to fish caused during injection.

quote: However, the oral immunization method still requires fishing operation, uses a large amount of vaccine, and vaccine components are easily degraded by gastrointestinal proteases, losing immunogenicity, resulting in a relatively poor immune protection effect (19).
statement: 然而，口服免疫方法仍需要捕捞操作，使用大量疫苗，且疫苗成分易被胃肠道蛋白酶降解从而失去免疫原性，导致相对较差的免疫保护效果。
text_zh: 然而，口服免疫方法仍需要捕捞操作，使用大量疫苗，且疫苗成分易被胃肠道蛋白酶降解从而失去免疫原性，导致相对较差的免疫保护效果。
text_en: However, oral immunization methods still require harvesting operations, use large amounts of vaccine, and the vaccine components are easily degraded by gastrointestinal proteases, thereby losing immunogenicity, resulting in relatively poor immune protection effects.
limitations: 需要捕捞操作、使用大量疫苗
counterevidence: 免疫保护效果相对较差

quote: Immersion immunization involves immersing fish in water containing the vaccine for a period, which requires less manpower, allows immunization during transport, causes minimal fish injury, and can even avoid fishing during immunization.
statement: 浸泡免疫涉及将鱼浸入含有疫苗的水中一段时间，这需要较少的人力，允许在运输过程中进行免疫，造成最小的鱼体损伤，甚至可以在免疫期间避免捕捞。
text_zh: 浸泡免疫涉及将鱼浸入含有疫苗的水中一段时间，这需要较少的人力，允许在运输过程中进行免疫，造成最小的鱼体损伤，甚至可以在免疫期间避免捕捞。
text_en: Immersion vaccination involves immersing fish in water containing vaccine for a period of time, which requires less labor, allows immunization during transport, causes minimal damage to the fish body, and can even avoid capture during immunization.

quote: For serum samples, blood was drawn from the caudal vein of 10 randomly chosen healthy Carassius auratus on the 0, 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th d post immunization. The collection was performed post-anesthesia.
statement: 在免疫后第0、7、14、21和28天，对随机选择的10条健康鲫鱼进行尾静脉采血，且采血操作是在麻醉后进行的。
text_zh: 在免疫后第0、7、14、21和28天，对随机选择的10条健康鲫鱼进行尾静脉采血，且采血操作是在麻醉后进行的。
text_en: On days 0, 7, 14, 21 and 28 post-immunization, tail vein blood was collected from 10 randomly selected healthy crucian carp, and the blood collection procedure was performed after anesthesia.
intervention: Tail vein blood collection after anesthesia
outcome: 采样过程中的动物福利（通过麻醉减少应激）

quote: As for tissue samples, after the blood collection, the same fish were dissected to harvest specific organs and tissues, including the liver, kidneys, spleen, intestines, and gills.
statement: 关于组织样本，在采血后，对同批鱼进行解剖以获取肝脏、肾脏、脾脏、肠道和鳃等特定器官和组织。
text_zh: 关于组织样本，在采血后，对同批鱼进行解剖以获取肝脏、肾脏、脾脏、肠道和鳃等特定器官和组织。
text_en: Regarding tissue samples, after blood collection, fish from the same batch were dissected to obtain specific organs and tissues such as liver, kidney, spleen, intestine, and gills.
outcome: 终末取样与安乐死/屠宰实践

quote: According to the manufacturer’s instructions, we utilized ELISA kits from the Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute, Jiangsu, China, to analyze the enzyme activities of acid phosphatase (ACP), alkaline phosphatase (AKP), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and lysozyme (LZM).
statement: 根据制造商说明，我们使用了来自南京建成生物工程研究所的ELISA试剂盒来分析酸性磷酸酶（ACP）、碱性磷酸酶（AKP）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和溶菌酶（LZM）的酶活性。
text_zh: 根据制造商说明，我们使用了来自南京建成生物工程研究所的ELISA试剂盒来分析酸性磷酸酶（ACP）、碱性磷酸酶（AKP）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和溶菌酶（LZM）的酶活性。
text_en: According to the manufacturer's instructions, we used ELISA kits from Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute to analyze the enzyme activities of acid phosphatase (ACP), alkaline phosphatase (AKP), superoxide dismutase (SOD), and lysozyme (LZM).

quote: Fish in the IV group showed mild stress responses, with a slight reduction in feeding, but recovered to normal 6 h after immunization.
statement: IV组鱼表现出轻微应激反应，摄食量略有减少，但在免疫后6小时恢复正常。
text_zh: IV组鱼表现出轻微应激反应，摄食量略有减少，但在免疫后6小时恢复正常。
text_en: Fish in group IV showed a mild stress response and a slight decrease in feed intake, but returned to normal 6 hours after immunization.

quote: Fish in the OV group did not show any stress responses.
statement: OV组鱼未表现出任何应激反应。
text_zh: OV组鱼未表现出任何应激反应。
text_en: Fish in the OV group did not show any stress response.

quote: Upon dissection of fish from each group, there were no obvious pathological changes observed in the intestines, gills, kidneys, spleen, or liver of any group (Figure 2A).
statement: 解剖各组鱼类后，观察到各组鱼的肠道、鳃、肾脏、脾脏或肝脏均无明显病理变化。
text_zh: 解剖各组鱼类后，观察到各组鱼的肠道、鳃、肾脏、脾脏或肝脏均无明显病理变化。
text_en: After dissecting the fish in each group, no significant pathological changes were observed in the intestines, gills, kidneys, spleen or liver of the fish in any group.

quote: Notably, some fish in the ImV group experienced partial scale loss and even swelling and ulceration at the injection site (Figure 2B).
statement: 值得注意的是，ImV组中部分鱼在注射部位出现部分鳞片脱落，甚至肿胀和溃疡。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，ImV组中部分鱼在注射部位出现部分鳞片脱落，甚至肿胀和溃疡。
text_en: It is worth noting that some fish in the ImV group experienced partial scale loss at the injection site, and even swelling and ulceration.

quote: On the 35th d after the first immunization, 25 fish from each group were randomly selected for the challenge test by intraperitoneal injection of A.veronii TH0426 .
statement: 在首次免疫后的第35天，从每组随机选取25条鱼，通过腹腔注射A. veronii TH0426进行攻击试验。
text_zh: 在首次免疫后的第35天，从每组随机选取25条鱼，通过腹腔注射A. veronii TH0426进行攻击试验。
text_en: On day 35 after the first immunization, 25 fish were randomly selected from each group and challenged by intraperitoneal injection with A. veronii TH0426.

quote: The immune protective effect in each experimental group was observed.
statement: 观察了各实验组的免疫保护效果。
text_zh: 观察了各实验组的免疫保护效果。
text_en: The immune protection effects of each experimental group were observed.

quote: The experiment and control groups were observed for 14 ds, and any dead fish were promptly removed and recorded.
statement: 实验组和对照组观察14天，并及时移除和记录任何死亡的鱼。
text_zh: 实验组和对照组观察14天，并及时移除和记录任何死亡的鱼。
text_en: The experimental and control groups were observed for 14 days, and any dead fish were promptly removed and recorded.

quote: IpV group, OV group, and IV group showed a continuous upward trend from the start of the initial immunization, reaching their respective peaks on the 28th d, then the IgM content began to decline, and by the 35th day after immunization, compared to the control group, the IgM content in the serum of the Carassius auratus in each immunized group was still significantly increased (p
statement: IpV、OV和IV免疫组在初次免疫开始后IgM含量呈持续上升趋势，于第28天达到峰值后开始下降，但在免疫后第35天，各组血清IgM含量仍显著高于对照组。
text_zh: IpV、OV和IV免疫组在初次免疫开始后IgM含量呈持续上升趋势，于第28天达到峰值后开始下降，但在免疫后第35天，各组血清IgM含量仍显著高于对照组。
text_en: The IgM content in the IpV, OV, and IV immunization groups showed a continuous upward trend after the start of primary immunization, reaching a peak on day 28 before beginning to decline; however, on day 35 post-immunization, serum IgM levels in all groups remained significantly higher than those in the control group.

quote: In the intraperitoneal vaccine group (IpV group) and the intramuscular vaccine group (ImV group), the fish were subjected to either intraperitoneal injections or dorsal fin muscle injections of the attenuated vaccine strain ΔhisJ .
statement: 在腹腔疫苗组和肌肉疫苗组中，鱼分别接受减毒疫苗株ΔhisJ的腹腔注射或背鳍肌肉注射。
text_zh: 在腹腔疫苗组和肌肉疫苗组中，鱼分别接受减毒疫苗株ΔhisJ的腹腔注射或背鳍肌肉注射。
text_en: In the intraperitoneal vaccine group and the muscle vaccine group, fish received intraperitoneal injection or dorsal fin muscle injection of the attenuated vaccine strain ΔhisJ, respectively.

quote: After soaking for 30 min, they were transferred to a vaccine-free aquarium.
statement: 浸泡30分钟后，将它们转移到无疫苗的水族箱中。
text_zh: 浸泡30分钟后，将它们转移到无疫苗的水族箱中。
text_en: After soaking for 30 minutes, they were transferred to aquaria without vaccine.

quote: A second round of immersion vaccination was conducted 14 ds later.
statement: 14天后进行了第二轮浸泡疫苗接种。
text_zh: 14天后进行了第二轮浸泡疫苗接种。
text_en: A second round of immersion vaccination was performed after 14 days.

quote: For both the intraperitoneal PBS group (IpP group) and the intramuscular PBS group (ImP group), the Carassius auratus were injected with 0.2 mL of PBS per fish, either intraperitoneally or in the dorsal fin muscle, with a follow-up injection on the 14th d.
statement: 对于腹腔PBS组和肌肉PBS组，每条鲫鱼腹腔或背鳍肌肉注射0.2 mL PBS，并在第14天进行后续注射。
text_zh: 对于腹腔PBS组和肌肉PBS组，每条鲫鱼腹腔或背鳍肌肉注射0.2 mL PBS，并在第14天进行后续注射。
text_en: For the intraperitoneal PBS group and the muscle PBS group, each crucian carp received an intraperitoneal or dorsal fin muscle injection of 0.2 mL PBS, with a subsequent injection on day 14.

quote: The results of the bacterial load tests indicate that the vaccine strain ΔhisJ could gradually restrict the rapid proliferation of bacteria in the organ tissues of Carassius auratus , reducing the bacterial load in these tissues, thereby providing a certain level of immune protection against A.veronii .
statement: 疫苗株ΔhisJ能够逐渐限制Carassius auratus器官组织中细菌的快速增殖，降低这些组织中的细菌载量，从而对A. veronii提供一定程度的免疫保护。
text_zh: 疫苗株ΔhisJ能够逐渐限制Carassius auratus器官组织中细菌的快速增殖，降低这些组织中的细菌载量，从而对A. veronii提供一定程度的免疫保护。
text_en: The vaccine strain ΔhisJ can gradually limit the rapid proliferation of bacteria in the organs and tissues of Carassius auratus, reducing the bacterial load in these tissues, thereby providing a certain degree of immune protection against A. veronii.

quote: Notably, there were significant differences in the bacterial load in the organs of Carassius auratus immunized via different routes with the vaccine strain ΔhisJ .
statement: 值得注意的是，通过不同途径接种疫苗株ΔhisJ的Carassius auratus器官中的细菌载量存在显著差异。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，通过不同途径接种疫苗株ΔhisJ的Carassius auratus器官中的细菌载量存在显著差异。
text_en: It is noteworthy that there were significant differences in bacterial loads in the organs of Carassius auratus vaccinated with strain ΔhisJ via different routes.

quote: Fish vaccinated via intraperitoneal injection had the lowest bacterial load in their organs on the 3th and 5th d post-challenge, followed by those in the ImV group, the OV group, and the IV group.
statement: 腹腔注射接种疫苗的鱼在攻击后第3天和第5天器官中的细菌载量最低，其次是ImV组、OV组和IV组。
text_zh: 腹腔注射接种疫苗的鱼在攻击后第3天和第5天器官中的细菌载量最低，其次是ImV组、OV组和IV组。
text_en: Fish vaccinated by intraperitoneal injection had the lowest bacterial loads in organs on day 3 and day 5 post-challenge, followed by the ImV group, OV group, and IV group.

quote: However, following the vaccination of the vaccine test groups, from the 7th d of immunization, there was a significant upward trend in the phagocytic ratio of each vaccine immunization group, followed by a slight decrease on the 14th d.
statement: 然而，在疫苗试验组接种疫苗后，从免疫第7天起，每个疫苗免疫组的吞噬比例呈显著上升趋势，随后在第14天略有下降。
text_zh: 然而，在疫苗试验组接种疫苗后，从免疫第7天起，每个疫苗免疫组的吞噬比例呈显著上升趋势，随后在第14天略有下降。
text_en: However, in the vaccine trial group, after vaccination, the phagocytosis ratio showed a significant upward trend from day 7 post-immunization onwards, followed by a slight decrease on day 14.
outcome: 非特异性免疫（吞噬作用）

quote: results showed that (Figure 6), at all the testing days except the 0 d, the expression levels of IL-1β and TNF-α in the OV and IV groups were higher than those in the BC group.
statement: 除第0天外，OV组和IV组中IL-1β和TNF-α的表达水平均高于BC组。
text_zh: 除第0天外，OV组和IV组中IL-1β和TNF-α的表达水平均高于BC组。
text_en: Except for day 0, the expression levels of IL-1β and TNF-α in the OV and IV groups were higher than those in the BC group.

quote: The clinical symptoms exhibited by Carassius auratus infected with the wild-type strain A.veronii TH0426 and the vaccine ΔhisJ included darkening of the body, slowed swimming, floating to the surface, surface bleeding, abdominal swelling, and in severe cases, skin ulcers.
statement: 感染野生型菌株TH0426和疫苗株ΔhisJ的金鱼表现出体色变黑、游动缓慢、浮于水面、体表出血、腹部肿胀以及严重时的皮肤溃疡等临床症状。
text_zh: 感染野生型菌株TH0426和疫苗株ΔhisJ的金鱼表现出体色变黑、游动缓慢、浮于水面、体表出血、腹部肿胀以及严重时的皮肤溃疡等临床症状。
text_en: Goldfish infected with the wild-type strain TH0426 and the vaccine strain ΔhisJ exhibited clinical symptoms including darkening of body color, slow swimming, floating at the water surface, bleeding on the body surface, abdominal swelling, and skin ulcers in severe cases.

quote: In the groups of Carassius auratus immunized via intraperitoneal vaccination (IpV), intramuscular vaccination (ImV), immersion vaccination (IV), oral vaccination (OV), and intraperitoneal PBS injection (IpP), there were no instances of death following the administration of the vaccine or PBS.
statement: 通过腹腔注射、肌肉注射、浸泡、口服免疫及腹腔注射PBS的金鱼组在给予疫苗或PBS后均无死亡发生。
text_zh: 通过腹腔注射、肌肉注射、浸泡、口服免疫及腹腔注射PBS的金鱼组在给予疫苗或PBS后均无死亡发生。
text_en: No deaths occurred in any of the goldfish groups administered with vaccine or PBS via intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, immersion, oral immunization, and intraperitoneal injection of PBS.

quote: Fish in the IpV and ImV, groups exhibited strong stress responses, showing signs of poor mental state, reduced feeding, slow swimming, and floating to the water surface, but they returned to normal the next day.
statement: 腹腔注射和肌肉注射组的鱼表现出强烈的应激反应，包括精神状态差、摄食减少、游动缓慢和浮于水面，但第二天恢复正常。
text_zh: 腹腔注射和肌肉注射组的鱼表现出强烈的应激反应，包括精神状态差、摄食减少、游动缓慢和浮于水面，但第二天恢复正常。
text_en: Fish in the intraperitoneal injection (IpV) and intramuscular injection (ImV) groups showed a strong stress response, including poor mental state, reduced feeding, slow swimming, and floating at the surface, but returned to normal by the next day.
counterevidence: 虽然出现强烈应激，但次日恢复正常。

quote: This study found that under the four immunization routes, the LD 50 of the vaccine strain ΔhisJ in Carassius auratus was significantly lower than that of the parental strain A.veronii TH0426 , and it did not cause severe pathological changes, indicating its safety in Carassius auratus .
statement: 研究发现，在四种免疫途径下，疫苗株ΔhisJ对鲫鱼的LD50显著低于亲本菌株A. veronii TH0426，且未引起严重的病理变化，表明其对鲫鱼是安全的。
text_zh: 研究发现，在四种免疫途径下，疫苗株ΔhisJ对鲫鱼的LD50显著低于亲本菌株A. veronii TH0426，且未引起严重的病理变化，表明其对鲫鱼是安全的。
text_en: The study found that under four immunization routes, the LD50 of vaccine strain ΔhisJ for crucian carp was significantly lower than that of the parent strain A. veronii TH0426, and it did not cause severe pathological changes, indicating that it is safe for crucian carp.

quote: It’s worth mentioning that fish in the IpV and ImV groups exhibited strong stress reactions.
statement: 值得注意的是，IpV和ImV组中的鱼表现出强烈的应激反应。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，IpV和ImV组中的鱼表现出强烈的应激反应。
text_en: It is worth noting that the fish in the IpV and ImV groups exhibited a strong stress response.

quote: Based on the instruction manuals of the fish IgM ELISA kit (Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute, Jiangsu, China), and the fish complement proteins C3 and C4 ELISA kits (Yan Domain Chemical Reagent Co., Ltd., Shanghai, China), the levels of IgM antibodies, C3 and C4 in serum were measured using a double-antibody sandwich ELISA method.
statement: 根据鱼IgM ELISA试剂盒和鱼补体蛋白C3及C4 ELISA试剂盒的说明书，使用双抗体夹心ELISA法测定血清中IgM抗体、C3和C4的水平。
text_zh: 根据鱼IgM ELISA试剂盒和鱼补体蛋白C3及C4 ELISA试剂盒的说明书，使用双抗体夹心ELISA法测定血清中IgM抗体、C3和C4的水平。
text_en: According to the instructions of the fish IgM ELISA kit and the fish complement protein C3 and C4 ELISA kits, serum levels of IgM antibodies, C3, and C4 were measured using a double antibody sandwich ELISA method.

quote: The results indicate that Carassius auratus immunized with the vaccine strain ΔhisJ have a certain protective effect against A.veronii infection.
statement: 用疫苗株ΔhisJ免疫的鲫鱼对维氏气单胞菌感染具有一定的保护作用。
text_zh: 用疫苗株ΔhisJ免疫的鲫鱼对维氏气单胞菌感染具有一定的保护作用。
text_en: Crucian carp immunized with the vaccine strain ΔhisJ have a certain protective effect against Aeromonas veronii infection.

quote: The protection rates vary with different immunization routes. The most effective immunization route is intraperitoneal injection, followed by muscle injection, oral immunization, and soaking immunization, in decreasing order of protection effectiveness.
statement: 不同免疫途径的保护率不同，腹腔注射最有效，其次是肌肉注射、口服免疫和浸泡免疫。
text_zh: 不同免疫途径的保护率不同，腹腔注射最有效，其次是肌肉注射、口服免疫和浸泡免疫。
text_en: The protection rate varies by different immune routes; intraperitoneal injection is the most effective, followed by intramuscular injection, oral immunization, and immersion immunization.

quote: However, on the 3th and 5th d post-challenge, the bacterial load in the organs of fish in the immunized groups was generally lower than that in their respective control groups.
statement: 在攻毒后第3天和第5天，免疫组鱼器官中的细菌载量通常低于各自的对照组。
text_zh: 在攻毒后第3天和第5天，免疫组鱼器官中的细菌载量通常低于各自的对照组。
text_en: On days 3 and 5 post-challenge, bacterial loads in the organs of immunized fish were generally lower than those in their respective control groups.

quote: Additionally, the bacterial load on the 5th d was lower than on the 3th d, indicating a decreasing trend in bacterial load over time in the immunized groups.
statement: 此外，第5天的细菌载量低于第3天，表明免疫组随时间推移细菌载量呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 此外，第5天的细菌载量低于第3天，表明免疫组随时间推移细菌载量呈下降趋势。
text_en: In addition, the bacterial load on day 5 was lower than that on day 3, indicating a downward trend in bacterial load over time in the immunized group.

quote: In a previous study, a hisJ gene-deleted strain of A.veronii TH0426 (namely ΔhisJ) was constructed and tested for immune protective effects in Loaches , achieving a survival rate of 65.66%, indicating its potential as a live attenuated vaccine (16).
statement: 在泥鳅中测试的ΔhisJ减毒株实现了65.66%的存活率，表明其作为活疫苗潜力。
text_zh: 在泥鳅中测试的ΔhisJ减毒株实现了65.66%的存活率，表明其作为活疫苗潜力。
text_en: The ΔhisJ attenuated strain tested in loach achieved a survival rate of 65.66%, indicating its potential as a live vaccine.

quote: Administering the vaccine to Carassius auratus using safe doses by intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, oral immunization, and immersion immunization did not cause severe damage to the fish, indicating good safety of these four immunization methods.
statement: 使用安全剂量通过腹腔注射、肌肉注射、口服和浸泡免疫方式给鲫鱼接种疫苗未造成严重伤害，表明这四种免疫方法安全性良好。
text_zh: 使用安全剂量通过腹腔注射、肌肉注射、口服和浸泡免疫方式给鲫鱼接种疫苗未造成严重伤害，表明这四种免疫方法安全性良好。
text_en: Vaccinating crucian carp via intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, oral administration, and immersion immunization at safe doses did not cause serious harm, indicating that these four immunization methods have good safety.

quote: Blood immune index tests and challenge protection experiments showed that all four immunization methods provided good immune protection effect, with the effectiveness decreasing in the following order: intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, oral, and immersion vaccination.
statement: 血液免疫指标检测和攻毒保护实验显示，所有四种免疫方法均提供了良好的免疫保护效果，有效性依次降低：腹腔注射、肌肉注射、口服和浸泡接种。
text_zh: 血液免疫指标检测和攻毒保护实验显示，所有四种免疫方法均提供了良好的免疫保护效果，有效性依次降低：腹腔注射、肌肉注射、口服和浸泡接种。
text_en: Blood immune indicator tests and challenge protection experiments showed that all four immunization methods provided good immune protection effects, with effectiveness decreasing in the following order: intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, oral administration, and immersion vaccination.

quote: Live attenuated vaccines can provide protection against infection in the host and prevent the spread of pathogens.
statement: 减毒活疫苗可以为宿主提供针对感染的保护并防止病原体传播。
text_zh: 减毒活疫苗可以为宿主提供针对感染的保护并防止病原体传播。
text_en: Live attenuated vaccines can provide the host with protection against infection and prevent pathogen transmission.
outcome: 感染防护与病原体传播控制

quote: Across the four inoculation routes, the highest bacterial concentration at which Carassius auratus did not die when inoculated with ΔhisJ was 2 × 10 7 CFU/mL.
statement: 在四种接种途径中，当用 ΔhisJ 接种鲫鱼（Carassius auratus）时，未导致死亡的最高细菌浓度为 2 × 10^7 CFU/mL。
text_zh: 在四种接种途径中，当用 ΔhisJ 接种鲫鱼（Carassius auratus）时，未导致死亡的最高细菌浓度为 2 × 10^7 CFU/mL。
text_en: Among the four inoculation routes, when crucian carp (Carassius auratus) were inoculated with ΔhisJ, the highest bacterial concentration that did not cause mortality was 2 × 10^7 CFU/mL.

quote: The results indicated that all four vaccine immunization routes could stimulate Carassius auratus to produce specific humoral immunity, but the intraperitoneal injection route of vaccination had the best immunization effect.
statement: 结果表明所有四种疫苗免疫途径都能刺激鲫鱼产生特异性体液免疫，但腹腔注射途径的免疫效果最好。
text_zh: 结果表明所有四种疫苗免疫途径都能刺激鲫鱼产生特异性体液免疫，但腹腔注射途径的免疫效果最好。
text_en: The results showed that all four vaccine immunization routes could stimulate specific humoral immunity in crucian carp, but the intraperitoneal injection route had the best immunization effect.

quote: On the 0 d, the phagocytic ratio ranged between 10.01–13.73%, with no significant differences among the seven groups including the control group.
statement: 在第0天，吞噬比例介于10.01-13.73%之间，包括对照组在内的七个组之间没有显著差异。
text_zh: 在第0天，吞噬比例介于10.01-13.73%之间，包括对照组在内的七个组之间没有显著差异。
text_en: On day 0, the phagocytosis ratio ranged between 10.01-13.73%, with no significant difference among the seven groups, including the control group.
outcome: 非特异性免疫（吞噬作用）基线

quote: enged with a virulent strain shows variation depending on the route of vaccination with the vaccine strain ΔhisJ .
statement: The response to challenge with a virulent strain varies depending on the route of vaccination with the vaccine strain ΔhisJ.
text_en: The response to challenge with a virulent strain varies depending on the route of vaccination with the vaccine strain ΔhisJ.

quote: Furthermore, post-vaccination, the spread of A.veronii in the organ tissues can be restricted.
statement: After vaccination, the spread of A. veronii in organ tissues can be restricted.
text_en: After vaccination, the spread of A. veronii in organ tissues can be restricted.
outcome: 病原菌组织扩散/感染控制

quote: Additionally, using agglutination tests to detect specific antibodies in serum, it was found that antibody titers in all immunization groups peaked on the 28th d after vaccination and then gradually declined.
statement: 此外，使用凝集试验检测血清中的特异性抗体发现，所有免疫组的抗体滴度在接种疫苗后第28天达到峰值，随后逐渐下降。
text_zh: 此外，使用凝集试验检测血清中的特异性抗体发现，所有免疫组的抗体滴度在接种疫苗后第28天达到峰值，随后逐渐下降。
text_en: In addition, using agglutination tests to detect specific antibodies in serum found that antibody titers in all immunized groups peaked on day 28 after vaccination and then gradually declined.

quote: We chose a random field of vision to scrutinize the white blood cells, evaluating their phagocytic activity towards bacteria.
statement: 选择随机视野仔细检查白细胞，评估其对细菌的吞噬活性。
text_zh: 选择随机视野仔细检查白细胞，评估其对细菌的吞噬活性。
text_en: Select random fields to carefully examine leukocytes and assess their phagocytic activity against bacteria.

quote: This observation was pivotal for determining the Phagocytic Percentage (PP) of white blood cells using the formula Equation 1 : (1) P P = Number of white blood cells phagocytizing bacteria / Total number of white blood cells × 100 %
statement: 这一观察对于使用公式确定白细胞的吞噬百分比(PP)至关重要：PP = 吞噬细菌的白细胞数量 / 白细胞总数 × 100%。
text_zh: 这一观察对于使用公式确定白细胞的吞噬百分比(PP)至关重要：PP = 吞噬细菌的白细胞数量 / 白细胞总数 × 100%。
text_en: This observation is crucial for using the formula to determine the phagocytosis percentage (PP) of white blood cells: PP = number of white blood cells that phagocytose bacteria / total number of white blood cells × 100%.

quote: In the experiments by Zhang et al., the live attenuated vaccine ΔhisJ immunized Loaches by immersion and intraperitoneal injection, with anti-inflammatory (IL-10 and TGF-β) and pro-inflammatory (IL-1β and TNF-α) factors in the liver and spleen of Loaches peaking and then stabilizing within 28 ds post-immunization, which is not entirely consistent with our findings.
statement: Zhang等人的实验显示，通过浸浴和腹腔注射减毒活疫苗ΔhisJ免疫泥鳅后，其肝脏和脾脏中的抗炎因子（IL-10和TGF-β）及促炎因子（IL-1β和TNF-α）在免疫后28天内达到峰值并趋于稳定，这与本研究结果不完全一致。
text_zh: Zhang等人的实验显示，通过浸浴和腹腔注射减毒活疫苗ΔhisJ免疫泥鳅后，其肝脏和脾脏中的抗炎因子（IL-10和TGF-β）及促炎因子（IL-1β和TNF-α）在免疫后28天内达到峰值并趋于稳定，这与本研究结果不完全一致。
text_en: Experiments by Zhang et al. showed that after immunizing loach with attenuated live vaccine ΔhisJ via immersion and intraperitoneal injection, anti-inflammatory factors (IL-10 and TGF-β) and pro-inflammatory factors (IL-1β and TNF-α) in the liver and spleen peaked within 28 days post-immunization and tended to stabilize, which is not completely consistent with the results of this study.
intervention: Immersion and IP injection of ΔhisJ
counterevidence: 与当前研究结果不完全一致

quote: In the experiments by Ma et al., a constructed Streptococcus DNA vaccine combined with the polymer PLGA to prepare an oral vaccine for Tilapia showed that the expression levels of pro-inflammatory cytokine genes such as IL-1β and TNF-α in the spleen and kidney tissues of Tilapia increased significantly and then decreased, similarly to the results of the oral vaccine group with Carassius auratus (33).
statement: Ma等人的实验表明，结合聚合物PLGA制备的链球菌DNA口服疫苗使罗非鱼脾脏和肾脏组织中的促炎细胞因子基因（如IL-1β和TNF-α）表达水平显著升高后下降，这与鲫鱼的口服疫苗组结果相似。
text_zh: Ma等人的实验表明，结合聚合物PLGA制备的链球菌DNA口服疫苗使罗非鱼脾脏和肾脏组织中的促炎细胞因子基因（如IL-1β和TNF-α）表达水平显著升高后下降，这与鲫鱼的口服疫苗组结果相似。
text_en: Ma et al.'s experiment showed that the streptococcal DNA oral vaccine prepared with the polymer PLGA caused a significant increase followed by a decrease in the expression levels of pro-inflammatory cytokine genes (such as IL-1β and TNF-α) in the spleen and kidney tissues of tilapia, which was similar to the results in the oral vaccine group for crucian carp.
outcome: 促炎细胞因子基因表达

quote: The Carassius auratus in each group were intraperitoneally injected with the wild strain A.veronii TH0426 on the 35th d after immunization to measure the immune protection effect.
statement: 在免疫后第35天，各组鲫鱼被腹腔注射野生型A. veronii TH0426菌株以测量免疫保护效果。
text_zh: 在免疫后第35天，各组鲫鱼被腹腔注射野生型A. veronii TH0426菌株以测量免疫保护效果。
text_en: On day 35 post-immunization, each group of crucian carp was intraperitoneally injected with wild-type A. veronii strain TH0426 to measure immune protection efficacy.

quote: The Carassius auratus in the IpP, ImP and BC group all died within 6–7 ds after the challenge, exhibiting typical characteristics such as scale loss, bleeding, and abdominal swelling.
statement: IpP、ImP和BC组的鲫鱼在攻毒后6-7天内全部死亡，表现出鳞片脱落、出血和腹部肿胀等典型特征。
text_zh: IpP、ImP和BC组的鲫鱼在攻毒后6-7天内全部死亡，表现出鳞片脱落、出血和腹部肿胀等典型特征。
text_en: Crucian carp in the IpP, ImP, and BC groups all died within 6-7 days post-challenge, exhibiting typical characteristics such as scale loss, hemorrhage, and abdominal swelling.

quote: On the 14th d after the challenge, the survival rate of the fish was 64% in the IpV group, 56% in the ImV group, 52% in the OV group, and 48% in the IV group.
statement: 攻毒后第14天，IpV组鱼的存活率为64%，ImV组为56%，OV组为52%，IV组为48%。
text_zh: 攻毒后第14天，IpV组鱼的存活率为64%，ImV组为56%，OV组为52%，IV组为48%。
text_en: On day 14 after challenge, the survival rate of fish in the IpV group was 64%, in the ImV group was 56%, in the OV group was 52%, and in the IV group was 48%.

quote: All experiments in this research were performed according to the permit guidelines established by the Institute of Hydrobiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and the experimental protocols were approved by the animal care and use committee of Institute of Hydrobiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.
statement: 所有实验均按照中国科学院水生生物研究所制定的许可指南进行，且实验方案已获该所动物护理和使用委员会批准。
text_zh: 所有实验均按照中国科学院水生生物研究所制定的许可指南进行，且实验方案已获该所动物护理和使用委员会批准。
text_en: All experiments were conducted in accordance with the permitted guidelines established by the Institute of Hydrobiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and the experimental protocols were approved by the Animal Care and Use Committee of the institute.

quote: In summary, these results show that using the vaccine strain ΔhisJ and immunizing Carassius auratus through different routes activated both non-specific and specific immune responses, with response intensity from high to low in the order of intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, oral vaccination, and immersion vaccination.
statement: 使用ΔhisJ疫苗株并通过不同途径对鲫鱼进行免疫接种激活了非特异性和特异性免疫反应，反应强度从高到低依次为腹腔注射、肌肉注射、口服疫苗和浸泡疫苗。
text_zh: 使用ΔhisJ疫苗株并通过不同途径对鲫鱼进行免疫接种激活了非特异性和特异性免疫反应，反应强度从高到低依次为腹腔注射、肌肉注射、口服疫苗和浸泡疫苗。
text_en: Immunization of crucian carp with the ΔhisJ vaccine strain via different routes activated non-specific and specific immune responses, with response intensity ranging from high to low as follows: intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, oral vaccination, and immersion vaccination.

quote: The results showed a relative survival rate of 64% in the IpV group, 56% in the ImV group, 52% in the OV group, and 48% in the IV group, indicating that different vaccination routes can provide varying degrees of protection to Carassius auratus .
statement: 结果显示腹腔注射组相对存活率为64%，肌肉注射组为56%，口服疫苗组为52%，浸泡疫苗组为48%，表明不同的疫苗接种途径可以为鲫鱼提供不同程度的保护。
text_zh: 结果显示腹腔注射组相对存活率为64%，肌肉注射组为56%，口服疫苗组为52%，浸泡疫苗组为48%，表明不同的疫苗接种途径可以为鲫鱼提供不同程度的保护。
text_en: The results showed that the relative survival rate was 64% for the intraperitoneal injection group, 56% for the intramuscular injection group, 52% for the oral vaccine group, and 48% for the immersion vaccine group, indicating that different vaccination routes can provide varying levels of protection to crucian carp.

quote: Although the injection immunization routes showed the highest protection rates compared to immersion and oral routes, both intramuscular and intraperitoneal injections caused varying degrees of injury to the fish, potentially leading to inflammation at the injection site and secondary bacterial infections (18 , 20 , 34).
statement: 尽管注射免疫途径与浸泡和口服途径相比显示出最高的保护率，但肌肉注射和腹腔注射均对鱼类造成不同程度的伤害，可能导致注射部位炎症和继发性细菌感染。
text_zh: 尽管注射免疫途径与浸泡和口服途径相比显示出最高的保护率，但肌肉注射和腹腔注射均对鱼类造成不同程度的伤害，可能导致注射部位炎症和继发性细菌感染。
text_en: Although the injectable immunization route showed the highest protection rate compared to immersion and oral routes, both intramuscular and intraperitoneal injections caused varying degrees of injury to fish, potentially leading to inflammation at the injection site and secondary bacterial infections.

quote: The research indicates that oral and immersion immunization methods are less effective, but they cause relatively less stress and injury to the fish.
statement: 研究表明口服和浸泡免疫方法效果较差，但对鱼类造成的应激和伤害相对较少。
text_zh: 研究表明口服和浸泡免疫方法效果较差，但对鱼类造成的应激和伤害相对较少。
text_en: Studies show that oral and immersion immunization methods are less effective, but cause relatively less stress and harm to fish.

quote: It is particularly noteworthy that, although the immune protective effect of intraperitoneal and intramuscular injection routes is superior to oral and immersion immunization, the injection routes may cause injury to the fish, with oral immunization routes offering better protection than immersion.
statement: 值得注意的是，尽管腹腔和肌肉注射途径的免疫保护效果优于口服和浸泡免疫，但注射途径可能会对鱼造成伤害，且口服免疫途径提供的保护优于浸泡免疫。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，尽管腹腔和肌肉注射途径的免疫保护效果优于口服和浸泡免疫，但注射途径可能会对鱼造成伤害，且口服免疫途径提供的保护优于浸泡免疫。
text_en: It is worth noting that although the immunoprotective effects of intraperitoneal and intramuscular injection routes are superior to those of oral and immersion immunization, the injection routes may cause harm to fish, and the protection provided by the oral immunization route is superior to that of immersion immunization.
outcome: 免疫效果与物理损伤权衡
counterevidence: 注射途径造成鱼体损伤

quote: This study aims to determine the active compound content and appropriate concentration of wedge sea hare extract (Dolabella auricularia) using the microencapsulation method to treat Aeromonas hydrophila bacterial which infected in comet fish (Carassius auratus auratus).
statement: 本研究旨在利用微胶囊化方法确定楔形海兔提取物（Dolabella auricularia）的活性化合物含量和适当浓度，以治疗感染嗜水气单胞菌的金鱼（Carassius auratus auratus）。

text_en: This study aims to use the microencapsulation method to determine the active compound content and appropriate concentration of wedge sea hare extract (Dolabella auricularia) for treating goldfish (Carassius auratus auratus) infected with Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: The results of the present study showed that weight gain and specific growth rate of fish fed one meal per day were significantly lower than those of fish fed three and four meals per day, were not affected by two meals per day.

statement: 붕어 치어의 성장과 사료 이용성을 고려할 때, 1일 3회 만복 공급이 최적의 사료 공급 횟수로 판단된다.
text_en: 붕어 치어의 성장과 사료 이용성을 고려할 때, 1일 3회 만복 공급이 최적의 사료 공급 횟수로 판단된다.

quote:
If the right dose is given, the immunostimulatory
compounds contained in the microcapsules can work
optimally to increase the body's immune system
(Rhamadhani et al. 2015).
statement: 如果给予正确的剂量，微胶囊中包含的免疫刺激化合物可以最佳地工作以增强身体的免疫系统。
text_zh: 如果给予正确的剂量，微胶囊中包含的免疫刺激化合物可以最佳地工作以增强身体的免疫系统。
text_en: If given the correct dose, the immunostimulatory compounds contained in microcapsules can work optimally to enhance the body's immune system.

quote:
The
preparation of D. auricularia bioactive through the
microcapsule method is expected to be effective in
controlling fish disease and subsequently will support
aquaculture health management.
statement: 通过微胶囊法制备D. auricularia生物活性物质预计能有效控制鱼类疾病，从而支持水产养殖健康管理。
text_zh: 通过微胶囊法制备D. auricularia生物活性物质预计能有效控制鱼类疾病，从而支持水产养殖健康管理。
text_en: Bioactive substances of D. auricularia prepared by the microencapsulation method are expected to effectively control fish diseases, thereby supporting aquaculture health management.

quote: This study also measured the bacterial load in various organs of Carassius auratus post-challenge, finding that different immunization routes significantly reduced bacterial load in organs like the liver, spleen, and kidneys.
statement: 本研究测量了攻毒后鲫鱼各器官的细菌载量，发现不同的免疫途径显著降低了肝脏、脾脏和肾脏等器官中的细菌载量。
text_zh: 本研究测量了攻毒后鲫鱼各器官的细菌载量，发现不同的免疫途径显著降低了肝脏、脾脏和肾脏等器官中的细菌载量。
text_en: This study measured the bacterial load in various organs of crucian carp after challenge, and found that different immunization routes significantly reduced the bacterial load in organs such as the liver, spleen, and kidney.

quote: The results suggest that the vaccine can limit the rapid proliferation of bacteria in the tissues of Carassius auratus , potentially helping to alleviate bacterial enteritis and septicemia.
statement: 结果表明该疫苗能限制鲫鱼组织中细菌的快速增殖，可能有助于缓解细菌性肠炎和败血症。
text_zh: 结果表明该疫苗能限制鲫鱼组织中细菌的快速增殖，可能有助于缓解细菌性肠炎和败血症。
text_en: The results showed that this vaccine could limit the rapid proliferation of bacteria in crucian carp tissues, and may help alleviate bacterial enteritis and septicemia.

quote: This also explains why the vaccinated Carassius auratus gradually stop dying after 7 ds post-immunization.
statement: 这也解释了为什么接种后的鲫鱼在免疫后7天逐渐停止死亡。
text_zh: 这也解释了为什么接种后的鲫鱼在免疫后7天逐渐停止死亡。
text_en: This also explains why crucian carp after vaccination gradually stopped dying 7 days post-immunization.

quote: In conclusion, this study demonstrates that the vaccine ΔhisJ can be used as a live attenuated vaccine for Carassius auratus , with good genetic stability and safety.
statement: 总之，本研究表明ΔhisJ疫苗可作为鲫鱼的减毒活疫苗，具有良好的遗传稳定性和安全性。
text_zh: 总之，本研究表明ΔhisJ疫苗可作为鲫鱼的减毒活疫苗，具有良好的遗传稳定性和安全性。
text_en: In conclusion, this study indicates that the ΔhisJ vaccine can serve as a live attenuated vaccine for crucian carp, exhibiting good genetic stability and safety.

quote: Vaccination through different routes can enhance the immune level of Carassius auratus and provide certain protection against A.veronii infection.
statement: 通过不同途径接种疫苗可以提高鲫鱼的免疫水平，并对维氏气单胞菌感染提供一定的保护。
text_zh: 通过不同途径接种疫苗可以提高鲫鱼的免疫水平，并对维氏气单胞菌感染提供一定的保护。
text_en: Vaccination via different routes can improve the immune level of crucian carp and provide a certain degree of protection against Aeromonas veronii infection.

text_en: 이 연구는 반순환여과시스템 내에서 사료 공급 횟수가 붕어 치어의 성장, 사료 이용성 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사한다.

quote: 사육 실험 기간 동안의 모든 실험구의 생존율은 100%로 실험구간에 유의차가 없었다 (P>0.05).

text_en: 실험 기간 동안 모든 사료 공급 횟수 구간의 붕어 치어 생존율은 100%였으며, 구간 간에 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote: 증체율(Weight gain, WG)과 일간성장률 (Specific growth rate, SGR)은 1일 1회 공급 실험 구가 1일 3회와 4회 공급 실험구들보다 유의하게 낮은 결과를 나타내었으며(P<0.05), 1일 2회 공급 한 실험구간과는 유의한 차이가 없었다(P>0.05).
statement: 1일 1회 사료 공급 시 증체율과 일간성장률이 1일 3회 및 4회 공급보다 유의하게 낮았으나, 1일 2회 공급과는 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 1일 1회 사료 공급 시 증체율과 일간성장률이 1일 3회 및 4회 공급보다 유의하게 낮았으나, 1일 2회 공급과는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote: 사료효율(Feed efficiency, FE)과 단백질전환효율 (Protein efficiency ratio, PER)은 실험구간에 유의 한 차이가 없었다.
statement: 사료 공급 횟수에 따른 사료효율과 단백질전환효율에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 사료 공급 횟수에 따른 사료효율과 단백질전환효율에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote: 일간사료섭취율(Daily feed intake, DFI)과 일간단백질섭취율(Daily protein intake, DPI)은 1일 3회 공급실험구간까지는 사료 공급 횟수가 증가함에 따라 유의하게 증가하는 경향을 보였으나, 1일 3회와 4회 공급 실험구간 에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.
statement: 1일 3회까지 사료 공급 횟수 증가에 따라 일간사료섭취율과 일간단백질섭취율이 유의하게 증가하였으나, 1일 3회와 4회 사이에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.
text_en: 1일 3회까지 사료 공급 횟수 증가에 따라 일간사료섭취율과 일간단백질섭취율이 유의하게 증가하였으나, 1일 3회와 4회 사이에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

quote:
Feed efficiency and protein efficiency ratio were
not affected by feeding frequency.
