text_en: 사료 효율과 단백질 효율 비율은 사료 공급 빈도의 영향을 받지 않았다.

quote:
The crude lipid was significantly increased following to an increasing of
feeding frequency.
statement: 조지방 함량은 사료 공급 빈도가 증가함에 따라 유의하게 증가했다.
text_en: 조지방 함량은 사료 공급 빈도가 증가함에 따라 유의하게 증가했다.

quote:
Consequently, we can conclude that the optimum feeding frequency of juvenile crucian
carp appeared three meals per day
statement: 따라서 붕어 치어의 최적 사료 공급 횟수는 하루 세 번으로 결론지을 수 있다.
text_en: 따라서 붕어 치어의 최적 사료 공급 횟수는 하루 세 번으로 결론지을 수 있다.

quote:
특히, 사료 공급 횟수는 어류
의 사료 이용성, 성장 및 대사물질 배출에 영향
을 미치는 중요한 요인으로(Biswas et al., 2010),
statement: 사료 공급 횟수는 어류의 사료 이용성, 성장 및 대사물질 배출에 영향을 미치는 중요한 요인이다.
text_en: 사료 공급 횟수는 어류의 사료 이용성, 성장 및 대사물질 배출에 영향을 미치는 중요한 요인이다.

quote:
부적절한 사료 공급 횟수는 어류의 성장 및 사료
효율을 감소시키고, 궁극적으로 어류의 양식 생
산 비용을 증가시킨다(Lee et al., 2000b; Kim et
al., 2020).
statement: 부적절한 사료 공급 횟수는 어류의 성장 및 사료 효율을 감소시키고, 궁극적으로 어류의 양식 생산 비용을 증가시킨다.
text_en: 부적절한 사료 공급 횟수는 어류의 성장 및 사료 효율을 감소시키고, 궁극적으로 어류의 양식 생산 비용을 증가시킨다.

quote: The test feed during the experimental period was given to the test fish at a feeding frequency of 2 times a day and as much as 5% of the fish body biomass.
statement: 实验期间，测试饲料每天投喂两次，投喂量为鱼体生物量的5%。
text_zh: 实验期间，测试饲料每天投喂两次，投喂量为鱼体生物量的5%。
text_en: During the experimental period, the test feed was fed twice daily at a rate of 5% of the fish biomass.

quote: The fish had previously been acclimatized for 1 week in a fiber tank with a diameter of 150 cm and a height of 80 cm.
statement: 鱼类在直径150厘米、高80厘米的纤维罐中预先驯化了一周。
text_zh: 鱼类在直径150厘米、高80厘米的纤维罐中预先驯化了一周。
text_en: Fish were pre-acclimated for one week in fiber tanks with a diameter of 150 cm and a height of 80 cm.

quote: All treatments, including control, were challenged with 0.1 mL bacteria with a concentration of 107 CFU/mL based on the lethal dose 50 (LD50) determination.
statement: 所有处理组（包括对照组）均基于半数致死量（LD50）测定结果，接种了浓度为10^7 CFU/mL的细菌0.1毫升。
text_zh: 所有处理组（包括对照组）均基于半数致死量（LD50）测定结果，接种了浓度为10^7 CFU/mL的细菌0.1毫升。
text_en: All treatment groups (including the control group) were inoculated with 0.1 mL of bacteria at a concentration of 10^7 CFU/mL, based on the results of the median lethal dose (LD50) determination.

quote: However, high temperatures and mechanical stress, which are used in the processing of formulated feed, cause the deterioration of bioactive compounds (De Cruz et al. 2015).
statement: 然而，配方饲料加工中使用的高温和机械应力会导致生物活性化合物降解。
text_zh: 然而，配方饲料加工中使用的高温和机械应力会导致生物活性化合物降解。
text_en: However, high temperatures and mechanical stress used in the processing of formulated feeds lead to the degradation of bioactive compounds.
intervention: Heat and mechanical stress in feed processing
intervention_record: 饲料加工高温与机械应力
counterevidence: 高温和机械应力破坏生物活性化合物

quote:
Additionally, microencapsulation of
crude garlic extract as a feed substitute was found to have
demonstrated an effect on the growth, proximate
composition, immunological and antioxidant status of
rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) juveniles (Adineh et
al. 2020).
statement: 此外，作为饲料替代品的粗大蒜提取物的微胶囊化被发现对虹鳟鱼幼鱼的生长、近似组成、免疫和抗氧化状态产生了影响。
text_zh: 此外，作为饲料替代品的粗大蒜提取物的微胶囊化被发现对虹鳟鱼幼鱼的生长、近似组成、免疫和抗氧化状态产生了影响。
text_en: In addition, microencapsulation of crude garlic extract as a feed substitute was found to affect the growth, proximate composition, immune and antioxidant status of juvenile rainbow trout.
outcome: 生长、免疫及抗氧化状态

quote: 본 연구는 붕어 치어 사육시 사료 공급 횟수가 성장, 사료 이용성 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사하기 위해서 수행되었다.
statement: 본 연구는 붕어 치어 사육 시 사료 공급 횟수가 성장, 사료 이용성 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사하기 위해 수행되었다.
text_en: 본 연구는 붕어 치어 사육 시 사료 공급 횟수가 성장, 사료 이용성 및 체조성에 미치는 영향을 조사하기 위해 수행되었다.

quote: 실험시작 2주전부터 실험사료를 하루 2회 공급하면서 예비 사육하였다.
statement: 실험 시작 2주 전부터 실험사료를 하루 2회 공급하며 예비 사육을 진행했다.
text_en: 실험 시작 2주 전부터 실험사료를 하루 2회 공급하며 예비 사육을 진행했다.

quote: 붕어의 사육은 침전조(2,000 L) 1개와 실험수조(200 L) 8개가 1세트가 되도록 설계한 반순환 여과시스템에서 수온 24℃와 ... 유지하면서 실시하였다.
statement: 반순환 여과시스템을 사용하여 수온 24℃를 유지하며 사육을 실시했다.
text_en: 반순환 여과시스템을 사용하여 수온 24℃를 유지하며 사육을 실시했다.

quote: 동일한 사육환경인 수온(24℃)과 수질환경 (pH 6.4~7.7, DO 6.6~7.4)을 유지하면서 실시하였다.
statement: 수온 24℃, pH 6.4~7.7, 용존산소(DO) 6.6~7.4 mg/L의 환경을 유지했다.
text_en: 수온 24℃, pH 6.4~7.7, 용존산소(DO) 6.6~7.4 mg/L의 환경을 유지했다.

statement: 실험군별로 1일 4회, 3회, 2회, 1회의 빈도로 만복까지 사료를 공급했다.
text_en: 실험군별로 1일 4회, 3회, 2회, 1회의 빈도로 만복까지 사료를 공급했다.

quote: tricaine methanesulfonate (MS 222, Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA) 100 ppm 수용액에 마취시켜 실험어의 체장과 무게를 측정하였다.
statement: 체장 및 무게 측정을 위해 MS-222 100 ppm 수용액으로 어체를 마취시켰다.
text_en: 체장 및 무게 측정을 위해 MS-222 100 ppm 수용액으로 어체를 마취시켰다.

quote: The addition of D. auricularia extract microcapsules in the feed produced significantly different results on the blood profile, weight gain and survival.
statement: 在饲料中添加D. auricularia提取物微胶囊对血液指标、体重增加和存活率产生了显著不同的结果。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加D. auricularia提取物微胶囊对血液指标、体重增加和存活率产生了显著不同的结果。
text_en: The addition of D. auricularia extract microcapsules to feed produced significantly different results for blood parameters, weight gain, and survival rate.
outcome: 血液指标、生长性能及存活率

quote: The highest of total leukocytes, total erythrocytes, hematocrit and blood hemoglobin were obtained in addition to 7.7 g D. auricularia extract/kg of feed with respective values of 7.35±0.94×104 cell.mm-3, 2.83±0.03×106 cell.mm-3, 22.43±0.03% and 6.72±0.02 g.dL-1, respectively.
statement: 在每千克饲料添加7.7克D. auricularia提取物的处理组中，总白细胞、总红细胞、血细胞比容和血红蛋白含量最高。
text_zh: 在每千克饲料添加7.7克D. auricularia提取物的处理组中，总白细胞、总红细胞、血细胞比容和血红蛋白含量最高。
text_en: In the treatment group with 7.7 g of D. auricularia extract per kg of feed, total white blood cells, total red blood cells, hematocrit, and hemoglobin content were highest.
outcome: 血液指标（免疫与携氧能力）

quote: The highest relative survival and survival were found in the treatment of 7 and 7.7 g extract/kg of feed, which was 100%.
statement: 在每千克饲料添加7克和7.7克提取物的处理组中发现了最高的相对存活率和存活率，均为100%。
text_zh: 在每千克饲料添加7克和7.7克提取物的处理组中发现了最高的相对存活率和存活率，均为100%。
text_en: The highest relative survival rate and survival rate, both at 100%, were found in the treatment groups with 7 g and 7.7 g of extract added per kg of feed.

quote: This study concluded that microencapsulated with D. auricularia extract at dose 7 g extract/kg of feed was the optimum dose for C. a. auratus infected with A. hydrophila.
statement: 本研究得出结论，对于感染A. hydrophila的C. a. auratus，每千克饲料7克D. auricularia提取物微胶囊是最佳剂量。
text_zh: 本研究得出结论，对于感染A. hydrophila的C. a. auratus，每千克饲料7克D. auricularia提取物微胶囊是最佳剂量。
text_en: This study concluded that for C. a. auratus infected with A. hydrophila, the optimal dose of D. auricularia extract microcapsules is 7 g per kg of feed.

quote: Bacterial infection by A. hydrophila causes 80% of the deaths of cultured fish at various stages.
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌细菌感染导致养殖鱼类各阶段死亡率的80%。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌细菌感染导致养殖鱼类各阶段死亡率的80%。
text_en: Aeromonas hydrophila bacterial infection causes 80% mortality in farmed fish at all stages.

quote: The disease is characterized by the presence of gill and fin lesions, as well as skin ulceration (Pękala-Safińska 2018).
statement: 该疾病的特征是存在鳃和鳍病变以及皮肤溃疡。
text_zh: 该疾病的特征是存在鳃和鳍病变以及皮肤溃疡。
text_en: The disease is characterized by the presence of gill and fin lesions as well as skin ulcers.

quote: At a more severe level of infection, it causes flatulence, ulcers, and hemorrhagic (Kartikaningsih et al. 2020).
statement: 在更严重的感染水平下，它引起腹胀、溃疡和出血。
text_zh: 在更严重的感染水平下，它引起腹胀、溃疡和出血。
text_en: At more severe infection levels, it causes bloating, ulcers and bleeding.

quote: Internally, accumulation of ascitic fluid in the fish and it can damage to fish organs, especially the kidneys and liver, can be observed (Baumgartner et al. 2017).
statement: 内部观察显示，鱼体内腹水积聚并可能损害器官，特别是肾脏和肝脏。
text_zh: 内部观察显示，鱼体内腹水积聚并可能损害器官，特别是肾脏和肝脏。
text_en: Internal observations showed ascites accumulation in the fish body and possible damage to organs, especially the kidneys and liver.

quote: In some ornamental fish, it has been found that the bacteria Aeromonas spp. could be resistant to various types of antibiotics (Saengsitthisak et al. 2020).
statement: 在一些观赏鱼中，发现气单胞菌属细菌可能对多种抗生素具有耐药性。
text_zh: 在一些观赏鱼中，发现气单胞菌属细菌可能对多种抗生素具有耐药性。
text_en: In some ornamental fish, Aeromonas bacteria were found to possibly be resistant to multiple antibiotics.

quote: Therefore, a disease control strategy is thus needed to achieve a cultivation system that is safe, environmentally friendly, and will not prompt any bacteria-resistant effects.
statement: 因此，需要一种疾病控制策略来实现安全、环保且不会引发细菌耐药效应的养殖系统。
text_zh: 因此，需要一种疾病控制策略来实现安全、环保且不会引发细菌耐药效应的养殖系统。
text_en: Therefore, a disease control strategy is needed to achieve aquaculture systems that are safe, environmentally friendly, and do not induce bacterial resistance.
outcome: 养殖系统安全性与环境友好性

quote: Administration of H. scabra ethanol extract in fish feed can induce potential immunostimulant effect in the prevention of A. hydrophila infection.
statement: 在鱼饲料中添加糙海参乙醇提取物可诱导潜在的免疫刺激作用，从而预防嗜水气单胞菌感染。
text_zh: 在鱼饲料中添加糙海参乙醇提取物可诱导潜在的免疫刺激作用，从而预防嗜水气单胞菌感染。
text_en: Adding H. scabra ethanol extract to fish feed can induce potential immunostimulatory effects, thereby preventing Aeromonas hydrophila infection.
intervention: H. scabra ethanol extract in feed

quote: Fish blood was taken from the caudal vein and then the blood was put into the blood collection box for observation.
statement: 从尾静脉采集鱼血，并将血液放入采血管中以便观察。
text_zh: 从尾静脉采集鱼血，并将血液放入采血管中以便观察。
text_en: Fish blood was collected from the caudal vein and placed into a blood collection tube for observation.

quote: In addition, a blood profile was observed for the total leukocytes, erythrocytes, hematocrit, and hemoglobin.
statement: 此外，还观察了总白细胞、红细胞、血细胞比容和血红蛋白的血象指标。
text_zh: 此外，还观察了总白细胞、红细胞、血细胞比容和血红蛋白的血象指标。
text_en: In addition, hematological indicators including total white blood cells, red blood cells, hematocrit, and hemoglobin were observed.

quote: Likewise, weight gain and relative survival were also observed.
statement: 同样，也观察了增重和相对存活率。
text_zh: 同样，也观察了增重和相对存活率。
text_en: Similarly, weight gain and relative survival rate were also observed.

quote:
Measurement of the
hematocrit level was done by comparing the volume of
blood cells with the total volume of blood after being
centrifuged, expressed in percent.
statement: 血细胞比容水平通过比较离心后血细胞体积与全血总体积来测量，以百分比表示。
text_zh: 血细胞比容水平通过比较离心后血细胞体积与全血总体积来测量，以百分比表示。
text_en: Hematocrit levels are measured by comparing the volume of blood cells after centrifugation to the total volume of whole blood, expressed as a percentage.

quote:
Observation of clinical symptoms was carried out after
the bacterial test through observations of physical changes
(external) and changes in behavior. The physical changes
discerned consist of red spots, peeling scales, damaged
fins, protruding eyes (exophthalmia) and stomach bulging
(dropsy), whereas the behavioral changes consist of
response to feeding, response to swimming motion, and
response to shock or reflex.
statement: 细菌测试后通过观察外部身体变化和行为变化来观察临床症状，身体变化包括红斑、鳞片脱落、鳍损伤、突眼和腹水，行为变化包括对摄食、游泳运动以及休克或反射的反应。
text_zh: 细菌测试后通过观察外部身体变化和行为变化来观察临床症状，身体变化包括红斑、鳞片脱落、鳍损伤、突眼和腹水，行为变化包括对摄食、游泳运动以及休克或反射的反应。
text_en: After bacterial testing, clinical symptoms were observed by examining external body changes and behavioral changes. Body changes included erythema, scale loss, fin damage, exophthalmia, and ascites; behavioral changes included responses to feeding, swimming movement, and shock or reflex.

quote: Furthermore, in vivo test, which was done in goldfish, it showed that the active ingredients in sea cucumbers caused a better blood profile and also, they were potential as an immunostimulant (Azlan et al. 2021).
statement: 一项在金鱼中进行的体内试验表明，海参中的活性成分改善了血液指标，并具有作为免疫刺激剂的潜力。
text_zh: 一项在金鱼中进行的体内试验表明，海参中的活性成分改善了血液指标，并具有作为免疫刺激剂的潜力。
text_en: An in vivo trial conducted in goldfish showed that the active components from sea cucumbers improved blood indicators and have potential as immunostimulants.

quote: Tannin from the extract of Centella asiatica plants has been proven to overcome the problem of bacterial pathogens in aquaculture (Rukisah et al. 2019).
statement: 单宁酸（来自积雪草提取物）已被证明能克服水产养殖中的细菌病原体问题。
text_zh: 单宁酸（来自积雪草提取物）已被证明能克服水产养殖中的细菌病原体问题。
text_en: Tannic acid (from Centella asiatica extract) has been shown to overcome bacterial pathogen problems in aquaculture.

quote: The reasons for using the microencapsulation technique are to increase stability, reduce side effects and toxic effects of drugs or to protect the digestive tract, especially the stomach, from irritation caused by the active ingredients of the drug, and control the time of drug release
statement: 微囊化技术的使用理由包括增加稳定性、减少药物的副作用和毒性作用，或保护消化道（特别是胃）免受药物活性成分引起的刺激，以及控制药物释放时间。
text_zh: 微囊化技术的使用理由包括增加稳定性、减少药物的副作用和毒性作用，或保护消化道（特别是胃）免受药物活性成分引起的刺激，以及控制药物释放时间。
text_en: The reasons for using microencapsulation technology include increasing stability, reducing the side effects and toxic effects of drugs, or protecting the digestive tract (especially the stomach) from irritation caused by active drug ingredients, as well as controlling drug release time.
outcome: 消化健康与药物安全性

quote: The parameters of blood profile and fish survival after challenge with bacteria, it was shown that immunostimulation with extracts in the form of microencapsulated is possible to be applied in the control of bacterial diseases.
statement: Immunostimulation using microencapsulated extracts can be applied to control bacterial diseases, as indicated by blood profile parameters and fish survival rates after bacterial challenge.
text_en: Immunostimulation using microencapsulated extracts can be applied to control bacterial diseases, as indicated by blood profile parameters and fish survival rates after bacterial challenge.

quote: On the 30 days of fish rearing after the administration of microencapsulation, the total number of leukocytes of C. a. auratus had shown an increase (Table 1).
statement: 在投喂微胶囊制剂后的第30天，金鱼（C. a. auratus）的白细胞总数有所增加。
text_zh: 在投喂微胶囊制剂后的第30天，金鱼（C. a. auratus）的白细胞总数有所增加。
text_en: On the 30th day after feeding with microencapsulated preparations, the total white blood cell count of goldfish (C. a. auratus) increased.

quote: Also, when the fish infected with A. hydrophila, the total number of leukocyte increases was also observed.
statement: 此外，当鱼感染嗜水气单胞菌时，也观察到白细胞总数增加。
text_zh: 此外，当鱼感染嗜水气单胞菌时，也观察到白细胞总数增加。
text_en: In addition, an increase in total white blood cell count was also observed when fish were infected with Aeromonas hydrophila.
outcome: 疾病应激下的免疫反应

quote: Jantan et al. (2015) stated that phytochemicals such as lactones and alkaloids have a role in stimulating the immune system or as an immunomodulator.
statement: Jantan等人（2015）指出，内酯和生物碱等植物化学物质在刺激免疫系统或作为免疫调节剂方面发挥作用。
text_zh: Jantan等人（2015）指出，内酯和生物碱等植物化学物质在刺激免疫系统或作为免疫调节剂方面发挥作用。

statement: 붕어 치어의 일간사료섭취율은 사료 공급 횟수가 1일 3회까지 증가하면 상승하지만, 그 이상에서는 더 이상 증가하지 않는다.

statement: 다른 어종 연구에서도 적정 사료 공급 횟수를 초과하면 성장과 사료 섭취율이 더 이상 증가하지 않는다는 결과가 보고되었다.
text_en: 다른 어종 연구에서도 적정 사료 공급 횟수를 초과하면 성장과 사료 섭취율이 더 이상 증가하지 않는다는 결과가 보고되었다.

quote: 본 연구결과에서 사료효율은 사료 공급 횟수에 따른 차이가 없었다.
statement: 본 연구 결과 사료 공급 횟수의 변화가 사료 효율에 영향을 미치지 않았다.
text_en: 본 연구 결과 사료 공급 횟수의 변화가 사료 효율에 영향을 미치지 않았다.

quote: 돌돔(Oplegnathus fasciatus)(Oh and Maran, 2014)과 rohu (Labeo rohita)(Biswas et al., 2006)의 경우 사료 공급 횟수가 사료효율에 영향을 미치지 않는 것으로 나타나 본 실험과 유사한 결과를 나타내었으나, 사료 공급 횟수가 사료효율에 영향을 미치는 결과도 있다(Kang et al., 2015; Kim et al., 2020; Kim YO, 2022).
statement: 선행 연구들 사이에서 사료 공급 횟수가 사료 효율에 영향을 주지 않는다는 결과와 영향을 준다는 결과가 혼재한다.
text_en: 선행 연구들 사이에서 사료 공급 횟수가 사료 효율에 영향을 주지 않는다는 결과와 영향을 준다는 결과가 혼재한다.
counterevidence: 사료 공급 횟수가 사료효율에 영향을 미치는 결과도 있다

quote: 사료 공급 횟수는 어체의 단백질, 수분 및 회분 함량에는 영향을 미치지 않았으나, 지질 함량에서는 사료 공급 횟수가 증가함에 따라 증가하였다.

quote: A high hematocrit level indicates the presence of contaminant and causes that fish to experience stress, it is different if the hematocrit level is low, it illustrates that fish lack vitamins, protein or fish are being infected, some fish that experience anemia have a high value of hematocrit as much as <10% (Witeska 2013; Destiani et al. 2019).
statement: 高血细胞比容水平表明存在污染物并导致鱼类经历应激；低血细胞比容水平说明鱼类缺乏维生素、蛋白质或正在被感染；一些贫血鱼类的血细胞比容值高达<10%。
text_zh: 高血细胞比容水平表明存在污染物并导致鱼类经历应激；低血细胞比容水平说明鱼类缺乏维生素、蛋白质或正在被感染；一些贫血鱼类的血细胞比容值高达<10%。
text_en: High hematocrit levels indicate the presence of pollutants and cause fish to experience stress; low hematocrit levels indicate that fish lack vitamins or protein, or are being infected; some anemic fish have hematocrit values as high as <10%.

day or after the challenge test using A. hydrophila bacteria
increased at the treatment dose of 7 g extract/kg feed and
7.7 g extract/kg feed, but it was different results with the
lowest dose treatment.
statement: 在第37天或使用嗜水气单胞菌进行攻击测试后，7克/公斤饲料和7.7克/公斤饲料处理组的总白细胞数增加，但最低剂量处理组的结果不同。
text_zh: 在第37天或使用嗜水气单胞菌进行攻击测试后，7克/公斤饲料和7.7克/公斤饲料处理组的总白细胞数增加，但最低剂量处理组的结果不同。
text_en: On day 37 or after challenge testing with Aeromonas hydrophila, total leukocyte counts increased in the 7 g/kg feed and 7.7 g/kg feed treatment groups, but results differed in the lowest dose treatment group.
intervention: Sea hare extract doses with bacterial challenge
intervention_record: 不同剂量海兔提取物结合细菌攻毒
limitations: 结果依赖于剂量，低剂量效果不同
counterevidence: 最低剂量处理组结果与其他高剂量组不同

quote:
It was because of its relation to the
concentration of the extract given, if the dose given were
right at that concentration, then the immunostimulatory
compound contained in the sea hare extract could work
optimally to improve the immune system of fish, and as a
result, A. hydrophila bacteria could not easily attack the
immune system of fish.
statement: 这是因为与给予的提取物浓度有关，如果剂量在该浓度下合适，海兔提取物中的免疫刺激化合物就能最佳地改善鱼的免疫系统，从而使嗜水气单胞菌不易攻击鱼的免疫系统。
text_zh: 这是因为与给予的提取物浓度有关，如果剂量在该浓度下合适，海兔提取物中的免疫刺激化合物就能最佳地改善鱼的免疫系统，从而使嗜水气单胞菌不易攻击鱼的免疫系统。
text_en: This is because it is related to the concentration of the extract administered; if the dose is appropriate at this concentration, the immunostimulatory compounds in the Aplysia extract can optimally improve the fish's immune system, thereby making Aeromonas hydrophila less able to attack the fish's immune system.

quote:

quote: Hematocrit levels in C. a. auratus showed an increase on the 30th day or after administration of microcapsules sea hare extract in the feed.
statement: 在饲料中添加海兔提取物微胶囊后，第30天金鱼的血细胞比容水平有所增加。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加海兔提取物微胶囊后，第30天金鱼的血细胞比容水平有所增加。
text_en: After adding microencapsulated Aplysia extract to the feed, the hematocrit levels of goldfish increased on day 30.

quote: The highest hematocrit level was found in the treatment of 7.7 g extract/kg feed, which indicated that the fish did not get stressed.
statement: 每千克饲料7.7克提取物的处理组血细胞比容最高，表明鱼未受到应激。
text_zh: 每千克饲料7.7克提取物的处理组血细胞比容最高，表明鱼未受到应激。
text_en: The treatment group with 7.7 g of extract per kg of feed had the highest hematocrit, indicating that the fish were not stressed.
intervention_record: 每千克饲料添加7.7克海兔提取物

quote: The results of the observation of hematocrit level on the 37th day or after the challenge test using A. hydrophila bacteria increased in treatments 7 and 7.7 g extract per kg of feed, while in the treatment of 6.3 g extract per kg of feed, it showed a decrease in hematocrit level when compared to the 30th day.
statement: 在使用嗜水气单胞菌进行攻击测试后的第37天，7和7.7 g/kg饲料提取物处理组的血细胞比容增加，而6.3 g/kg处理组相比第30天有所下降。
text_zh: 在使用嗜水气单胞菌进行攻击测试后的第37天，7和7.7 g/kg饲料提取物处理组的血细胞比容增加，而6.3 g/kg处理组相比第30天有所下降。
text_en: On day 37 after the challenge test with Aeromonas hydrophila, hematocrit increased in the 7 and 7.7 g/kg feed extract treatment groups, while it decreased compared to day 30 in the 6.3 g/kg treatment group.
intervention: Sea hare extract doses with bacterial challenge
intervention_record: 不同剂量海兔提取物结合细菌攻毒
outcome: 感染后的血细胞比容变化
counterevidence: 6.3 g/kg处理组血细胞比容下降

quote: The increase and decrease showed that C. a. auratus were still in good health.
statement: 血细胞比容的增加和减少表明金鱼仍处于健康状态。
text_zh: 血细胞比容的增加和减少表明金鱼仍处于健康状态。
text_en: The increase and decrease in hematocrit indicate that goldfish are still in a healthy state.
